Name: Abomination's Might
Description: Increases the attack power by 10% of party and raid members within 100 yards.      Increases your Strength by 2%.

Name: Blade Barrier
Description: Whenever your Blood Runes are on cooldown, you gain the Blade Barrier effect, which decreases damage taken by 5% for the next 10 sec.

Name: Bladed Armor
Description: Increases your melee attack power by 5 for every 250 armor value you have.

Name: Blood Gorged
Description: When you are above 75% health, you deal 10% more damage.  In addition, your attacks ignore up to 20% of your opponent's armor at all times.    The all-damage increase does not stack with Enhanced Weapon Mastery, Unending Fury, Answered Prayers, Blessed Weapons or Blood Presence. Only the highest increase applies.

Name: Bloodworms
Description: Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by a melee and spells by 6%.    Your weapon hits have a 9% chance to cause the target to spawn 2-4 Bloodworms.  Bloodworms attack your enemies, healing you as they do damage for 20 sec or until killed.

Name: Bloody Strikes
Description: Increases the damage of Blood Strike by 15% and Heart Strike by 45%.    Increases the damage of Blood Boil by 30%.

Name: Bloody Vengeance
Description: Gives you a 3% bonus to physical damage you deal for 30 sec after dealing a critical strike from a weapon swing, spell, or ability.  This effect stacks up to 3 times.

Name: Butchery
Description: Whenever you kill an enemy that grants experience or honor, you generate up to 20 rage.      You generate 2 rage per 5 sec while in combat.

Name: Dance Lessons
Description: Increases Dancing rune weapons's damage modifier by 25% and its duration by 4 sec.

Name: Dark Conviction
Description: Increases your chance to critically hit with weapons, spells and abilities by 5%.

Name: Death Rune Mastery
Description: Whenever you hit with Death Strike or Obliterate there is a 100% chance that the Frost and Unholy Runes will become Death Runes when they activate.    Death Runes count as a Blood, Frost or Unholy Rune.

Name: Improved Blood Presence
Description: Healing done to you is increased by 10% in Blood Presence.    Threat caused decreased by 20% while in Blood Presence.     Capstone Bonus: Increases the healing from your Blood Presence by an additional 3%.    Increases the damage done while in Blood Presence by an additional 8%.    While in Frost Presence or Unholy Presence, you retain 2% healing from Blood Presence.        The all-damage increase does not stack with Enhanced Weapon Mastery, Unending Fury, Answered Prayers, Blessed Weapons, Blood Gorged. Only the highest increase applies.

Name: Improved Death Strike
Description: Increases the damage of your Death Strike by 30%, increases its critical strike chance by 6%, and increases the healing granted by 50%.

Name: Improved Rune Tap
Description: Increases the health provided by Rune Tap by 100% and lowers its cooldown by 30 sec.

Name: Might of Mograine
Description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Blood Boil, Blood Strike, Death Strike, and Heart Strike abilities by 45%.

Name: Scent of Blood
Description: You have a 15% chance after dodging, parrying or taking direct damage to gain the Scent of Blood effect, causing your next 3 melee hits to generate 10 rage.

Name: Spell Deflection
Description: You have a chance equal to your Parry chance of taking 45% less damage from a direct damage spell.

Name: Subversion
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Blood Strike, Scourge Strike, Heart Strike and Obliterate by 9%.    Reduces all threat generated while in Blood or Unholy Presence by 25%.

Name: Sudden Doom
Description: Requires  Grave Coil (Rank 1)  Direct damage abilities and spells have a 9% chance to cast a free Grave Coil at your target.

Name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
Description: Increases the physical damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 4%.

Name: Vendetta
Description: Heals you for up to 6% of your maximum health whenever you kill a target that yields experience or honor.

Name: Veteran of the Third War
Description: Increases your total Strength by 6%, your Stamina by 3%, and your expertise by 6.

Name: Will of the Necropolis
Description: Damage that would take you below 35% health or taken while you are at 35% health is reduced by 15%.

Name: Acclimation
Description: When you are hit by a spell, you have a 30% chance to boost your resistance to that type of magic for 18 sec.  Stacks up to 3 times.

Name: Annihilation
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.      Your Obliterate will do its damage without consuming diseases.

Name: Black Ice
Description: Increases your Frost damage by 10%.    Increases your Shadow damage by 5%.

Name: Blood of the North
Description: Increases Blood Strike and Frost Strike damage by 10%.      Whenever you hit with Blood Strike or Pestilence there is a 100% chance that the Blood Rune will become a Death Rune when it activates.      Death Runes count as a Blood, Frost or Unholy Rune.

Name: Chilblains
Description: Victims of your Frost Fever disease are Chilled, reducing movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

Name: Chill of the Grave
Description: Your Chains of Ice, Howling Blast, Icy Touch and Obliterate generate 5.0 additional rage.

Name: Endless Winter
Description: Your strength is increased by 4%.    The cost of your Mind Freeze is reduced by 20 rage.

Name: Fortified Frost Presence
Description: While Frost Presence is active, its Stamina bonus is increased by 4%, Armor contribution from Cloth, Leather, Mail and Plate is increased by 30%, and damage taken is reduced by an additional 4%.

Name: Frigid Dreadplate
Description: Reduces the chance melee attacks will hit you by 3%.

Name: Glacier Rot
Description: Diseased enemies take 20% more damage from your Icy Touch, Howling Blast and Frost Strike.

Name: Guile of Gorefiend
Description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Blood Strike, Frost Strike, Howling Blast and Obliterate abilities by 45%.    Increases the duration of your Icebound Fortitude by 6 secs.

Name: Icy Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells by 6 yards, and the range of your Icy Touch, Chains of Ice, and Howling Blast by an additional 4 yards.    This does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Icy Talons
Description: You leech heat from victims of your Frost Fever, so that when their melee attack speed is reduced, yours increases by 20% for the next 20 sec.

Name: Improved Frost Presence
Description: While in Blood Presence or Unholy Presence, you retain 8% stamina from Frost Presence.    Damage done to you is decreased by an additional 2% in Frost Presence.

Name: Improved Icy Touch
Description: Your Icy Touch does an additional 15% damage and your Frost Fever reduces melee and ranged attack speed by an additional 6%.

Name: Killing Machine
Description: Your melee abilities have a chance to make your next Frost spell or ability guaranteed to critically strike.  Effect occurs more often than Killing Machine (Rank 4). Frostbrand attacks neither benefit from nor consume this effect.

Name: Merciless Combat
Description: Increases damage done by all frost spells and abilities by 12% to targets under 35% health.

Name: Nerves of Cold Steel
Description: Increases your chance to hit by 5%.    Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 33%.  Does not stack with Dual Wield Mastery

Name: Rime
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Icy Touch and Obliterate by 15%.    Casting Obliterate has a 45% chance to reset the cooldown on Howling Blast and cause your next Howling Blast to consume no runes.

Name: Runic Focus
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.     This does not stack with other similar effects.   Capstone Bonus: Diseased enemies take 4% more damage from you.

Name: Runic Power Mastery
Description: Increases your maximum rage by 20.

Name: Toughness
Description: Increases your armor value from items by 10%.    Reduces the duration of all movement slowing effects by 30%.

Name: Tundra Stalker
Description: Your spells and abilities deal 10% more damage to targets infected with your Frost Fever.    Increases your expertise by 5.

Name: Anticipation
Description: Increases your Dodge chance by 5%.    Does not stack with other Anticipation talents.

Name: Blood-Caked Blade
Description: Your auto attacks have a 30% chance to cause a Blood-Caked Strike, which hits for 25% weapon damage plus 12.5% for each of your diseases on the target.

Name: Crypt Fever
Description: Your Death Knight diseases also cause Crypt Fever, which increases disease damage taken by the target by 30%.

Name: Desecration
Description: Your Plague Strikes and Scourge Strikes cause the Desecrated Ground effect.  Targets in the area are slowed by 50% by the grasping arms of the dead while standing on the unholy ground.  Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Desolation
Description: Your Blood Strikes cause you to deal 5% additional damage with all attacks for the next 20 sec.

Name: Dirge
Description: Your Death Strike, Plague Strike and Scourge Strike generate 5.0 additional rage.

Name: Ebon Plaguebringer
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.    Your Crypt Fever morphs into Ebon Plague, which increases magic damage taken by 13% in addition to increasing disease damage taken.

Name: Epidemic
Description: Increases the duration of Blood Plague and Frost Fever by 6 sec.

Name: Frenzied Unholy Presence
Description: Increases your attack speed benefit of Unholy Presence by 10%.

Name: Improved Unholy Presence
Description: While in Blood Presence or Frost Presence, you retain 15% increased movement speed from Unholy Presence.     Your runes finish their cooldowns 10% faster in Unholy Presence.

Name: Impurity
Description: The attack power bonus of your Deathknight spells is increased by 20%.

Name: Magic Suppression
Description: You take 6% less damage from all magic.      Your Anti-Magic Shell absorbs an additional 25% of spell damage.

Name: Morbidity
Description: Increases the damage and healing of Grave Coil by 15%.    Reduces the cooldown on Death and Decay by 15 sec.

Name: Necrosis
Description: Your melee auto attacks deal an additional 20% Shadow damage.

Name: Night of the Dead
Description: Increases all damage done by 2%.    Reduces the cooldown on Army of the Dead by 4 min.

Name: On a Pale Horse
Description: You become as hard to stop as death itself.      The duration of all Stun and Fear effects used against you is reduced by 20%.    Your mounted speed is increased by 20%.    This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.  This does not stack with other Stun or Fear reduction effects.

Name: Outbreak
Description: Increases the damage of Plague Strike by 30% and Scourge Strike by 20%.

Name: Rage of Rivendare
Description: Your spells and abilities deal 10% more damage to targets infected with your Blood Plague.    Increases your expertise by 5.

Name: Ravenous Dead
Description: Increases your total Strength by 3% and the contribution your Ghouls get from your Strength and Stamina by 60%

Name: Reaping
Description: Whenever you hit with Blood Strike or Pestilence there is a 100% chance that the Blood Rune becomes a Death Rune when it activates.      Death Runes count as a Blood, Frost or Unholy Rune.

Name: Unholy Blight
Description: Causes the victims of your Grave Coil to be surrounded by a vile swarm of unholy insects, taking 50% of the damage done by the Grave Coil over 10 sec, and preventing any diseases on the victim from being dispelled.

Name: Unholy Command
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Death Grip ability by 10 sec.

Name: Vicious Strikes
Description: Increases the critical strike chance by 6% and critical strike damage bonus by 30% of your Plague Strike and Scourge Strike.

Name: Virulence
Description: Increases your hit chance by 3%.    Reduces the chance that your damage over time diseases can be cured by 30%.

Name: Wandering Plague
Description: When your Death Knight diseases damage an enemy, there is a chance equal to your melee critical strike chance that they will cause 100% additional damage to the target and all enemies within 8 yards.    Ignores any target under the effect of a spell that is cancelled by taking damage.

Name: Balance of Power
Description: Increases your hit chance by 4%.    Reduces your magic damage taken by 6%.

Name: Brambles
Description: Damage from your Thorns increased by 75% and damage done by your Treants increased by 15%.     Melee attacks done to you while you have Barkskin active have a 15% chance to daze the target for 3 sec.

Name: Celestial Bane
Description: Increases your Nature damage by 6% to targets affected by your Insect Swarm.  Increases your Critical Strike chance with Arcane spells 6% to targets affected by your Moonfire.

Name: Celestial Focus
Description: Increases your haste by 2%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 70%.

Name: Dreamstate
Description: Regenerate mana equal to 10% of your Intellect every 5 sec, even while casting.

Name: Earth and Moon
Description: Increases your spell damage by 6%.   Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge apply the Earth and Moon effect, which increases magic damage taken by 13% for 8 sec.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Eclipse
Description: Dealing direct Arcane damage grants you a 100% chance to increase the damage of your Wrath and Starsurge by 40% for 15 seconds.    Dealing direct Nature damage grants you a 100% chance to increase your critical strike chance with Starfire and Starsurge by 40% for 15 seconds.    Both effects cannot occur at the same time and each effect can only occur once every 30 seconds.

Name: Gale Winds
Description: Increases your Hurricane and Typhoon damage by 30%.

Name: Genesis
Description: Increases the periodic damage and healing of your spells by 10%.

Name: Improved Faerie Fire
Description: Your Faerie Fire spell also increases the chance the target will be hit by spell attacks by 3%.    Increases the critical strike chance of your damage spells by 3% on targets afflicted by Faerie Fire.

Name: Improved Moonfire
Description: Increases the damage of Moonfire spell by 15% and the critical strike chance of Starfire and Starsurge by 10%.  Capstone Bonus: Your direct Arcane damage critical hits on targets afflicted by your Moonfire instantly trigger an extra Arcane damage. This can happen once every 1.5 sec.

Name: Improved Moonkin Form
Description: Your Moonkin Aura also causes affected targets to gain 3% spell haste.   Does not stack with similar effects.  In Moonkin Form, you to gain 30% of your spirit as additional spell damage.

Name: Lunar Guidance
Description: Increases your spell damage by 12% of your Intellect.

Name: Moonfury
Description: Increases the damage of your Starfire, Moonfire, Wrath, and Starsurge by 10%.

Name: Moonglow
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Starfire, Wrath, Starsurge, Healing Touch, Regrowth, Rejuvenation, and Swiftmend spells by 9%.

Name: Nature's Grace
Description: Direct damaging or healing Druid spell criticals have a 100% chance to grant you Nature's Grace, increasing your haste by 20% for 4 sec.

Name: Nature's Majesty
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Wrath, Starfire, Starfall, Starsurge, Nourish and Healing Touch spells by 4%.

Name: Nature's Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells with a channeling or cast time by 6 yards.     Does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Your Nature non-periodic spells have a 100% chance to spread your Insect Swarm to all enemies within 5 yards, if hitting a target affected by Insect Swarm. This effect has a 6 sec internal cooldown.

Name: Nature's Splendor
Description: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation by 3 sec, your Regrowth by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm, Lifebloom, Efflorescence and Flourish by 2 sec.

Name: Owlkin Frenzy
Description: While in Moonkin Form, attacks against you have a 24% chance to trigger a Frenzy, increasing your damage done by 5%.     This also grants immunity to casting pushback for Balance spells and restores 2% base mana every 2 sec. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Starlight Wrath
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Wrath by 9%.    Increases the damage of Starfire and Starsurge by 6%.

Name: Vengeance
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.   Does not stack with similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Your direct Arcane and Nature criticals  have a chance to attract a Vengeful Soul, increasing your magic damage by 3% for 12 seconds. When this effect ends the Soul leaves your body, restoring 5% of your missing mana.

Name: Wrath of Cenarius
Description: Increases the spell damage scaling of your Starfire and Starsurge by 20% and the spell damage scaling of your Wrath by 10%.

Name: Brutal Impact
Description: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by 1 sec.    Reduces the cooldown of Bash by 30 sec.

Name: Elder Hide
Description: Increases the Armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 12%.

Name: Feral Aggression
Description: Increases the damage you do to targets above 75% health by 9%.    Increases your attack power while in Feral forms by 150% of your level.

Name: Feral Instinct
Description: Increases Swipe and Ravage damage by 30%.  Increases all damage dealt by 3% while Tiger's Fury is active.   Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling.   Capstone Bonus: Dealing damage with Swipe and Ravage reduce the cooldown of Tiger's Fury and Enrage by 1 second.

Name: Feral Swiftness
Description: Increases your movement speed by 20% in Cat Form.    Increases your chance to dodge while in Cat Form, Bear Form and Dire Bear Form by 4%.

Name: Ferocity
Description: Increases all attributes by 5% and reduces the energy cost of your Swipe (Cat), Claw, Rake and Mangle (Cat) abilities by 10 Energy.  Reduces the rage cost of your Maul, Swipe (Bear), and Mangle (Bear) by 5 Rage.

Name: Heart of the Wild
Description: Increases your Intellect by 9%.     While in Bear or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 6%.    While in Cat Form your attack power is increased by 6%.

Name: Improved Leader of the Pack
Description: Leader of the Pack also causes affected targets to heal themselves for 4% of their base health when they critically hit with a melee or ranged attack.      You gain 16% of your base mana when you benefit from this heal.    The healing effect cannot occur more than once every 6 sec.

Name: Improved Mangle
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Mangle (Bear) ability by 1.5 sec.     Reduces the energy cost of your Mangle (Cat) ability by 6.

Name: Improved Shapeshifting
Description: Your Druid shapeshifting spells now cause the act of shapeshifting to free the caster of Polymorph and movement impairment effects.    Increases the Armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 20% while in Bear Form.

Name: Infected Wounds
Description: Shred, Maul, Swipe, and Mangle attacks cause an Infected Wound in the target.     Infected Wound slows the target's movement speed by 50%, and reduces attack speed by 20%. Lasts 12 sec.  Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: King of the Jungle
Description: While in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, your Enrage ability increases physical damage done by 15%.  While in Cat Form, casting Tiger's Fury restores 60 energy.     Reduces the mana cost of Bear Form, Cat Form, and Dire Bear Form by 60%.  Capstone Bonus: The global cooldown of Cat Form and Bear Form is reduced by 0.5 sec.

Name: Natural Reaction
Description: Increases your chance to dodge by 6% while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form.    You regenerate 15 rage every time you dodge while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form.

Name: Nurturing Instinct
Description: Increases your healing spells by up to 70% of your Agility, and increases healing done to you by 20%  while in Cat form.

Name: Predatory Instincts
Description: While in Cat Form increases your damage from all critical strikes by 15% and reduces the damage taken from area of effect attacks by 10%.     This does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Predatory Strikes
Description: Reduces the energy cost of your Cat Form finishing moves by 9.     Your Feral finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point spent to make your next Nature spell with a base casting time less than 10 sec. become an instant cast spell.

Name: Primal Fury
Description: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage anytime you get a critical strike while in Bear and Dire Bear Form.    Your critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that add combo points have a 100% chance to add an additional combo point.

Name: Primal Gore
Description: Grants the periodic damage from your Lacerate and Rip abilities the ability to critically hit.

Name: Primal Precision
Description: Increases your energy regeneration rate by 20%.    Increases your Expertise by 10.    Cat Form finishing moves that fail to land are refunded 80% of the energy cost.  Capstone Bonus: Your Cat Form finishing moves reduce the cooldown of Berserk by 3 sec. and Tiger's Fury by 2 sec.

Name: Primal Tenacity
Description: While in Cat Form the duration of fear effects are reduced by 30% and all damage taken while stunned by 30%.

Name: Protector of the Pack
Description: While in Bear or Dire Bear Form your attack power is increased by 6% and the physical damage you take is reduced by 12%.

Name: Rend and Tear
Description: Increases damage done by your Maul and Shred attacks on bleeding targets by 20%.    Increases the critical strike chance of your Ferocious Bite ability on bleeding targets by 25%.

Name: Savage Defense
Description: Each time you critically strike with melee damage while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form you have a 100% chance to trigger Savage Defense.    When triggered versus players this effect has 8 sec cooldown and only reduces the damage taken by 1 hit.    Savage Defense Reduces damage from the next 3 physical attacks made against you by an amount equal to 3% of your maximum health plus 8% of your attack power.

Name: Savage Fury
Description: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Mangle (Cat), Mangle (Bear), and Maul abilities by 20%.

Name: Sharpened Claws
Description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities while in Bear, Dire Bear or Cat Form by 6%.

Name: Shredding Attacks
Description: Reduces the energy cost of your Shred ability by 18.    Reduces the rage cost of your Lacerate ability by 2.

Name: Survival of the Fittest
Description: While you are in Bear Form:    Increases all attributes by 6%.    Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 6%.    Increases your armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 33%.

Name: Empowered Touch
Description: Your Healing Touch gains an additional 40% and your Nourish and Flourish gain an additional 20% of your bonus healing effects.

Name: Furor
Description: Increases your Arcane and Nature spell damage done by 6%.     Increases your Stamina in Bear and Dire Bear Form by 9%.     Increases your damage in Cat Form by 6%.

Name: Gift of Nature
Description: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.    The healing increase does not stack with Spiritual Healing, Purification or Answered Prayers. Only the highest increase applies.

Name: Gift of the Earthmother
Description: Increases your spell haste by 10%.    Reduces the global cooldown of your Lifebloom spell by 10%.

Name: Improved Barkskin
Description: Grants 60% additional armor contribution from cloth and leather items while in Travel Form or while not shapeshifted.    Increases the damage reduction granted by your Barkskin spell by 10%.    Reduces the chance your Barkskin is dispelled by 70%.

Name: Improved Mark of the Wild
Description: Increases all of total attributes by 2%.    Increases the effects of your Mark of the Wild and Gift of the Wild spells by 40%.

Name: Improved Rejuvenation
Description: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 15%.

Name: Improved Tranquility
Description: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by 100%, and reduces the cooldown by 60%.

Name: Improved Tree of Life
Description: Increases your armor contribution from items while in Tree of Life Form by 80%    Increases your healing spell power by 15% of your spirit while in Tree of Life Form.

Name: Intensity
Description: Allows 25% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.    Your Enrage ability instantly generate 15 rage and 30% base mana.

Name: Living Seed
Description: Critical heals from your Druid direct Nature spells or Lesser Healing Wave have a 100% chance to plant a Living Seed on the target, storing 30% of the healing done.    Living Seed will bloom when the target is next hit by a direct spell or attack. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Living Spirit
Description: Increases your total Spirit by 15%.  Capstone Bonus: Your Rejuvenation now heals for an additional 50% on targets below 50% health.

Name: Master Shapeshifter
Description: Grants an effect which lasts while the Druid is within the respective shapeshift form.  Bear Form - Increases physical damage by 4%.  Cat Form - Increases melee critical strike chance by 4%.  Moonkin Form - Increases Arcane and Nature damage by 4%.  Tree of Life Form - Increases healing by 4%.

Name: Natural Perfection
Description: Your critical strike chance with all spells is increased by 3% and critical strikes against you give you the Natural Perfection effect reducing all damage taken by 4%.  Stacks up to 3 times.  Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Natural Shapeshifter
Description: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 30%.

Name: Naturalist
Description: Increases Physical damage done by 3%.    Increases critical strike chance of your Healing Touch by 9%.

Name: Nature's Bounty
Description: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth and Nourish spells by 25%.

Name: Nature's Focus
Description: Increases your haste by 2%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting any spells by 70%.

Name: Nature's Rejuvenation
Description: The bonus healing effects of your Nature healing over time spells is increased by 20%.

Name: Omen of Clarity
Description: Damage, healing and auto attacks have a 6% chance of causing you to enter a Clearcasting state.     The Clearcasting state reduces the Mana, Rage or Energy cost of your next damage, healing spell or offensive ability by 100%. This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

Name: Revitalize
Description: Your Rejuvenation, Wild Growth and Efflorescence spells have a 15% chance, and your Healing Touch and Regrowth has a 100% chance to restore 8 Energy, 4 Rage and 1% Mana.  Capstone Bonus: Healing a target to full health with Healing Touch will restore 30% of its mana cost.

Name: Subtlety
Description: Increases your haste by 3%.    Reduces the chance your helpful Druid spells, Moonfire, and Insect Swarm will be dispelled by 30%.    Capstone Bonus: All threat generated is reduced by 30%. This capstone effect does not stack with similar capstone effects.

Name: Tranquil Spirit
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch, Nourish and Tranquility spells by 15%.

Name: A Quick Death
Description: Using Execute or Kill Shot now grants you A Quick Death.    A Quick Death Melee and ranged haste increased by 3%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Abjurer's Ward: Arcane
Description: Absorbing damage with a Ward spell now reduces the cooldown of Presence of Mind by 10 seconds.

Name: Abjurer's Ward: Fire
Description: Absorbing damage with a Ward spell now reduces the cooldown of your Combustion by 10 seconds.

Name: Abjurer's Ward: Frost
Description: Absorbing damage with a Ward spell now reduces the cooldown of Cold Snap by 10 seconds.

Name: Absolute Hellfire
Description: Dealing damage with Flamestrike and Meteor marks the target for 3 sec.    Each tick of Rain of Fire triggers additional 1 Fire damage on the marked targets.    This uses Rain of Fire modifiers

Name: Accelerated Ascension
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Holy Fire by 5 seconds and increases its damage over time by 100%.

Name: Adrenaline Junkie
Description: Your finishing moves have a 4% chance per combo point to reduce the cooldown of Adrenaline Rush by 6 seconds.

Name: Adumbral Companion
Description: Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks now deal Shadow damage.    Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks can only be transformed to one damage type at once.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Aegis Overdrive
Description: Requires Mana-Forged Barrier.    Activating Mana Shield triggers Aegis Explosion. When Mana Shield expires or is fully depleted by damage, it triggers Aegis Explosion again.    Dodging, blocking or parrying an attack has a 20% chance to trigger Aegis Explosion while Mana Shield is active, this can only occur once every 5 seconds.    The activation explosion can not occur more than once every 4 sec.

Name: Aegis
Description: Each time a melee attack strikes you, you have a chance to gain 6 armor for 10 sec.

Name: Afflicted Soul
Description: Dealing damage with Drain Soul now applies Afflicted Soul, and consumes 12 stacks to apply Ruptured Soul.      Ruptured Soul You deal 25% increased periodic Shadow damage against the target. Lasts 30 sec.

Name: Against All Odds
Description: Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor while below 20% health instantly heals you for 10% of your health.    This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.

Name: Agile Coordination
Description: Your finishing moves have a 5% chance per combo point to grant your Tamed Pet Agile Coordination.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin or Tether Elemental, and Tame Beast.    Agile Coordination Increases your Tamed Pet's attack power by 15% of your Agility for 8 sec.

Name: Agonizing Coil
Description: Death Coil deals 200% increased damage.    Drain Life or Drain Soul damage over time has an 25% chance to reduce the cooldown of Death Coil by 8 seconds.    Death Coil deals 25% increased damage against players.

Name: Alembic
Description: Being hit by a melee or ranged attack now has a 5% chance to grant you 20% of your base mana.    This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.

Name: Aligned with Time
Description: Time-Bind now increases the healing your ally receives from your Align by 15%.

Name: All that is Right
Description: When Seal of Righteousness deals damage you gain a stack of All that is Right.      All that is Right Increases the damage of your Seal of Righteousness by 10% and Seal of Vengeance by 15%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 12 sec.  At max stacks, the duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Ambidextrous
Description: Your Single-Minded Fury off-hand attacks trigger an instant attack with your main-hand weapon and grant you Dominant.    Dominant Increases your attack power by 10% for 9 sec.  This effect can only occur once every 16 sec and Dominant cannot be active at the same time as Southpaw.

Name: Ambush Predator
Description: Dealing damage with Rake or Rip has a 10% chance and Shred has a 50% chance to grant you Ambush Predator.    Ambush Predator Your next Ravage can be cast outside of Prowl, has no positional requirement, and costs 60 less energy.

Name: An Honest Mistake
Description: Missing with a spell now increases your hit chance by 5% and spell haste by 5% for 10 sec.

Name: Arcane Aiming
Description: When Clearcasting is consumed, you gain Arcane Aiming.  Does not trigger from Elemental Clearcasting consumption.   Arcane Aiming Your next 3 Hunter Shots deal 11 additional Arcane damage and restore 6% of your total mana. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Arcane Arrows
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Missiles grants a charge or Arcane Arrows making your Auto Shot fire an additional projectile dealing arcane damage. Holds up to 10 charges. Lasts 15 seconds.

Name: Arcane Charge
Description: Charge and Feral Charge deal 8 Arcane damage to nearby enemies on impact, instantly restoring 3% of your missing mana and granting nearby allies Charged Brilliance, restoring 3% missing mana every second for 6 sec.

Name: Arcane Fulmination
Description: Increases your threat generated by Arcane damage by 40%.  Reduces all damage taken by 2%.

Name: Arcane Gunslinger
Description: Arcane Shot now grants you Arcane Gunslinger.      Arcane Gunslinger Your Arcane Barrage strikes 1 additional enemy, deals 25% increased damage, and has a 50% chance to grant you Missile Barrage. Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 8 sec or until you gain Missile Barrage.

Name: Arcane Infusion
Description: Increases critical strike chance of Arcane Shot by 15%.    Casting Arcane Shot grants you Arcane Infusion.    Arcane Infusion Grants you Missile Barrage at 3 stacks. Lasts 12 sec.    Missile Barrage Reduces the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 2.5 sec, reduces the mana cost by 100%, and the missiles fire every 0.4 sec. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Arcane Motes
Description: Your Arcane Missiles and Arcane Barrage now generate Arcane Motes.    Arcane Motes Increases the damage of your Starfire, Moonfire by 10%. Stacks up to 5. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Arcane Reloading
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Missiles reduces the active cooldown of Aimed Shot by 1.5 seconds.

Name: Arcane Reprisal
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Barrage reduces the cooldowns of Crusader Strike and Divine Storm by 3 seconds.

Name: Arcane Shelling
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Shot now grants you Arcane Shelling.    Arcane Shelling Your Arcane Barrage and Aimed Shot deal 30% increased damage. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts for 20 sec.

Name: Arcane Synergy
Description: Arcane Missiles now grant you Arcane Synergy.    Arcane Synergy The cast time of your next Starfire is reduced by 5%, and its damage increased by 5%. Stacks up to 20. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Arcane Thunder
Description: Arcane Missiles now channels for 2 more seconds. While channeling, your Lightning Bolt is transformed into Thunder Bolt and its damage is increased by 70%.  You can no longer trigger Missile Barrage.    Thunder Bolt Casts a bolt of arcane infused lightning at the target for 11 to 12 Spellstorm damage.     This spell is castable during the channeling of Arcane Missiles.

Name: Arcane Vanguard
Description: Dealing direct damage with Arcane Blast marks the target with Arcane Breach for 12 sec.    Casting Charge or Intercept on a target marked by you consumes Arcane Breach, triggers your highest known rank of Arcane Explosion 750 milliseconds later, and reduces the remaining cooldown of Blink by 5 sec.

Name: Archmage
Description: Increases the chance to trigger Missile Barrage and Brain Freeze by an additional 10%.

Name: Arctic Stalker
Description: Dealing damage with Aimed Shot or Steady Shot reduces the remaining cooldown of Deep Freeze by 1 sec.

Name: Armor of Faith
Description: When you cast Greater Heal or Flash Heal on an ally with Weakened Soul, they receive Armor of Faith, which heals them the next time they take damage. This healing is equal to 35% of the heal that granted them Armor of Faith.    This healing is equal to 10% of the triggering heal when activated by player damage.

Name: Armor of Wrath
Description: Casting Hammer of Wrath now reduces your damage taken by 12% for 6 sec.    This effect can only occur once every 12 sec.

Name: Arugal's Blink
Description: Casting Blink unleashes a wave of Shadow Bolts at your arrival point, dealing 65 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Arugal's Tainted Arcanum
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Missiles applies Tainted.      Tainted Increases your damage dealt to the target with Unstable Affliction by 65% and Curse of Agony by 65%.    Each tick consumes one charge. Stores up to 10 charges and lasts for 18 sec.

Name: Assuaging Shadows
Description: Casting Shadow Dance now releases a Shadow Nova.    Shadow Nova Deals -94 Shadow damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 80% for 3 seconds.

Name: Astral Fusion
Description: Dealing damage with Starfire or Wrath grants Astral Fusion.    Astral Fusion Reduces the cast time of your next Starsurge by 34% and increases its damage by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 8 sec.  Reaching 3 stacks resets the cooldown of Starsurge.

Name: Astral Realm
Description: Dealing damage with Thunderstorm restores an additional 10% of your maximum mana.    If a target player is afflicted by your Unrelenting Storm when damaged by Thunderstorm, you and your target are forced into an alternate dimension for 8 seconds, reducing the target's damage and healing by 20%.

Name: Atonement
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Dealing direct damage with Smite or Holy Fire triggers a heal on a nearby ally for 285.    Dealing periodic damage with Holy Fire triggers a heal on a nearby ally for 15.    Heals from Atonement benefit from healing modifiers and can trigger additional effects.

Name: Authority
Description: Execution Sentence periodic damage applies Authority, increasing damage taken from your next Shield of Righteousness by 10%. Stacks up to 4.     Consuming Authority reduces the damage you take by 3% per stack consumed for 8 sec.    Using Shield of Righteousness has a 20% chance to reset the cooldown of Execution Sentence.

Name: Avatar of Lightning
Description: Elemental Mastery sacrifices its instant cast and mana cost reduction to reduce its cooldown by 50% and allow you to cast Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning while moving.

Name: Bane of the Wicked
Description: Hammer of the Righteous now applies Bane of the Wicked to enemies hit.    Bane of the Wicked Increases Holy damage taken from you by 4% for 15 sec. Stacking up to 5.    The duration of Bane of the Wicked cannot be refreshed.

Name: Barrage Overload
Description: When Missile Barrage is consumed, you gain Barrage Overload.    Barrage Overload Your next Arcane Barrage causes you to overload, unleashing 1 arcane bolt per stack. Stacks up to 6 times. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Bathe in Blood
Description: Eviscerate, Envenom and Saber Slash now have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Bathe in Blood for each of your bleeds on the target.      Bathe in Blood Your bleeds deal 10% increased damage. Stacks up to 30 times and lasts 12 sec. At max stacks, the duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Battering Ram
Description: Casting Slam now ignores 15% armor.    Slam now applies a stack of Sunder Armor.    Sunder Armor Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 30 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Battle Cultist: Firebrand
Description: Melee critical strikes refresh your Immolate effect on the target.

Name: Battle Fatigue
Description: Your Warrior Shouts, Banners and Warcry now apply Battle Fatigue to enemies within 10 yards of you.    Your physical melee attacks and abilities have a 30% chance to increase the duration of Battle Fatigue by 1 sec.     This effect can only occur once every 30 sec from Warrior Shouts or Banners.    Battle Fatigue Increases your physical damage dealt to the target by 8%. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Battle Fervor
Description: Charge now grants you Battle Fervor.    This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.    Battle Fervor Increases your haste by 15% and movement speed by 30% for 4 sec.

Name: Battle Glaive
Description: Using 3 Warrior direct damaging abilities in quick succession resets the cooldown of Glaive Toss and increases the damage of your next Glaive Toss by 40%. Lasts 10 sec.  Does not work with 'on next swing' abilities.

Name: Battlemage
Description: Fireball, Frostbolt or Arcane Blast empowers your Warrior abilities to deal an additional 40% weapon damage as Fire, Frost or Arcane for 10 seconds.

Name: Bear Attack
Description: This seems to do nothing. Best keep on your toes though. Cause that's the thing about bear attacksâ€¦ They come when you least expect it.     Cannot be used with pets.

Name: Bestial Assault
Description: Casting direct damage Hunter abilities now grant you Bestial Assault    Bestial Assault Reaching 5 stacks restores a charge of Unrelenting Wrath. Lasts 12 sec.

Name: Big Flaming Grimfire
Description: Your Soul Fire has 30% increased critical strike chance.  Casting Pyroblast makes your next Soul Fire release a secondary projectile half as strong.  Casting Soul Fire extends the duration of Living Bomb on your target by 4 seconds.

Name: Biting Cold
Description: When your Deep Freeze deals damage, its cooldown is reduced by 33%.

Name: Biting Drain
Description: Grants the periodic damage from your Drain Life and Drain Soul spells the ability to critically hit.    Critical strike damage bonus of your Drain Life and Drain Soul is increased by 35%.

Name: Bitter Cold
Description: Casting Ice Barrier or Icebound Fortitude causes you to be surrounded by a bitter cold dealing 10 Frost damage every second to all enemies within 8 yards. Lasts for 10 sec.    While active, your damaging frost spells or abilities have a 20% chance to apply Sunder Armor to targets hit.

Name: Black Ice Arsenal
Description: Dealing damage with Howling Blast, Icy Touch, and Frost Strike applies Black Ice.      Black Ice Increases damage taken from the caster's next Frostbolt and Frostfire Bolt by 20%. Stacks up to 3. Lasts for 12 sec.

Name: Blade Vortex
Description: While Blade Flurry is active your damaging melee finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to create a Blade Vortex.      Blade Vortex Deals 5 Physical damage to nearby enemies every second for 3 sec.

Name: Blademaster
Description: Parrying an attack now grants you Blademaster.    Blademaster cannot trigger while it is active.    Blademaster Your blade is empowered for 10 sec.    - Devastate: Deals 50% additional damage to nearby enemies and reduces their armor by an additional 10%.    - Death Strike: Hits 2 additional targets.    - Riposte: Awards 2 additional combo points and slows the target's attack speed by an additional 10%.

Name: Blades of Blood
Description: Using Charge or Colossus Smash grants you Blades of Blood.    Blades of Blood Your Whirlwind now hits 5 additional targets and applies a Rend (if known). Lasts 3 sec.

Name: Blaze Ward
Description: Taking direct damage or avoiding attacks has a chance to activate Blaze Aura.    Blaze Aura Ignites the area surrounds you, causing 5 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 5 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.

Name: Blaze
Description: Your Fire Blast spreads your Immolate to enemies within 10 yards. The spread Immolate cannot critically strike.

Name: Blessed by the Elune
Description: Solar Eclipse causes your next Wrath or Starsurge to apply Insect Swarm.    Lunar Eclipse causes your next Starfire or Starsurge to apply Moonfire.

Name: Blessing of the Divines
Description: Your direct Holy and Nature heals now have a 10% chance to trigger a random blessing.    This effect can only occur once every 1 sec and can only trigger from heals with a resource cost.    Blessing of the Titan Increases the target's Health by 5% and reduces damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.    Blessing of Creation Grants 12 mana, 22 energy, and 10 rage to you and your party.    Blessing of Time Increases you and your target's spell haste by 10% for 10 sec.    Blessing of Mending Heals party members within 30 yards of you -39.    Blessing of the Divines Heals party members within 30 yards of you for -30 every 3 seconds for 15 sec.

Name: Blighted Edge
Description: Scourge Strike deals 15% increased damage.  Its Shadow damage is increased by an additional 25% against targets affected by your Unholy Blight.

Name: Blind Rage
Description: You now generate 10 rage after each missed attack.

Name: Blinding Dispersion
Description: Dispersion's cooldown is now reduced by 10 seconds. When Dispersion ends, a shadowy nova blinds and disorients nearby enemies for 2 sec.

Name: Blink and you'll miss it!
Description: Your damaging spells with a cast time reduce the cooldown of Blink by 1 seconds.    This effect can only occur once every 1 sec and only works against creatures.

Name: Blood and Guts
Description: Using Execute on targets affected by your Disembowel deals 203 damage to 5 nearby enemies. This explosion deals 30% increased damage against monsters.    This damage uses Execute modifiers.

Name: Blood Bane
Description: Dealing periodic damage with Rend or Deep Wounds grants Blood Bane.    Dealing damage with Deadly Poison grants Venom Coated Blade.      Blood Bane Increases the damage of your Deadly Poison by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 8 sec.    Venom Coated Blade Increases the damage of your next 5 Instant Poisons by 100%. Lasts 16 sec.

Name: Blood Drinker
Description: Your Bloodthirst now consumes Taste for Blood to heal you for 3.

Name: Blood Hunting
Description: Critical strikes with Hunter abilities against targets afflicted by your Piercing Shots randomly reduce the cooldown of either: - Kill Command by 3 sec - Frenzy Shot by 3 sec - Bestial Wrath by 7 sec  Abilities you do not currently have learned can still be randomly selected for the cooldown reduction.

Name: Blood Rain
Description: Your Stormstrike now increases your bleed damage against the target by 30% for 6 sec.

Name: Blood Shield
Description: Requires Frost Presence.    Death Strike also shields you for 100% of the healing done for 12 sec.    The shield stacks with its remaining absorb and is capped at 20% of your maximum health, or 10% against players.

Name: Blood Venom
Description: Bloodthirst makes your Envenom preserve 2 combo points.    Envenom used this way increases the damage done by Warrior abilities by 20% for 8 seconds.

Name: Bloodletter's Rhythm
Description: Blood Strike grants Bloodletter's Rhythm.      Bloodletter's Rhythm At 3 stacks, your next Heart Strike, Rune Strike, or Death Strike costs no resource. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Bloodletting
Description: Rupture deals 25% more damage to targets affected by Rend.    Rend deals 30% more damage to targets affected by Rupture.

Name: Bloodstained Recklessness
Description: Killing an enemy during Recklessness extends its duration by 3 seconds.    This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.

Name: Bloody Business
Description: Casting Mangle 3 times within 5 sec, spreads your Pounce to up to 7 nearby targets.

Name: Bloody Claws
Description: Claw costs 12 less energy and gains additional damage equal to 20% of your attack power.

Name: Bloody Maelstrom
Description: Consuming Maelstrom Weapon at max stacks empowers your next Bloodthirst, Mortal Strike or Heart Strike to deal 8 Elemental damage to 6 nearby enemies.     Bloody Maelstrom deals 15% more damage per stack. Stacks up to 5. Lasts 12 seconds.

Name: Bloody Resets
Description: Hemorrhage and Ghostly Strike can now trigger your Sword and Board talent.

Name: Blooming Growth
Description: Critically healing with Regrowth now applies its heal over time effect to 3 party or raid members within 20 yards.    Regrowth effects applied this way have their healing reduced by 10%.

Name: Blooming Power
Description: Casting Swiftmend increases your next Regrowth's chance to critically heal by 100%.    Swiftmend now grants you Nature's Grace.    Nature's Grace Increases your haste by 20% for 4 sec.

Name: Blunt Force Trauma
Description: Your Damage Shield talent now deals additional threat and applies Blunt Force Trauma.   Blunt Force Trauma Bleeding for 3 damage every 3 seconds and your Damage Shield deals 50% increased damage against the target. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 9 sec.     This cannot trigger other effects

Name: Boomer
Description: Direct damage Fire spells have a chance to cause an explosion around you, dealing -15 and increase your spell critical strike chance by 3% for 5 sec.    This effect can only occur once every 8 sec.

Name: Booming Thunder
Description: Dealing direct Nature damage with spells grants Booming Thunder.   Booming Thunder Increases the damage of your next Earth Shock by 25% and increases its critical strike chance by 3%. Against monsters, Earth Shock deals an additional 5% damage per stack. Stacks up to 25 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Borrowing Time
Description: Casting Align, Renew and Synchronize now grants you Borrowed Time.    Borrowed Time Grants spell haste for your next spell after casting Power Word: Shield.  This effect is not consumed by instant-cast spells.

Name: Boundless Salvation
Description: Your direct Holy heals reduce the cooldown of Tyr's Deliverance by 4 sec.  Holy Light reduces the cooldown of Tyr's Deliverance by an additional 5 sec.

Name: Brand of the Pyromaniac
Description: Combustion also causes your next two Pyroblasts to bounce to 2 additional enemies, dealing 30% less damage with each bounce.

Name: Bright Lights
Description: Holy Fire grants you Light's Grace.    Your Light's Grace talent also increases your spell haste and Holy damage by 3%.    Light's Grace The cast time of your next Holy Light spell is reduced by 0.5 sec. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Brilliance of Faith
Description: Divine Favor now empowers the cast and further empowers 2 casts of the spell that consumed it.  Holy Shock - Has no cooldown and has its global cooldown reduced by 33%.  Flash of Light - Heals up to 3 targets.  Holy Light - Heals for 30% more.

Name: Built up Thirst
Description: Finishing moves grant you Built up Thirst.      Built up Thirst Increases the damage of your next Bloodthirst by 20% per combo point consumed. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Bullseye!
Description: Disengage now doubles the effectiveness of your Piercing Shots talent and makes your hunter shots ignore 40% of your target's armor for 10 seconds.

Name: Burning Desire
Description: Increases the damage taken by your Hellfire ability by 8% and increases the damage it deals by 25%.

Name: Burst of Flames
Description: Dealing periodic damage with Corruption, Conflagrate, Immolate and Shadowflame now grants you Pyromancers Kindling.     Pyromancers Kindling Your next Pyroblast deals 8% increased damage. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 6 sec.

Name: By Fire Be Purged
Description: Fire Nova now purges a beneficial spell effect from damaged targets.    This effect can only occur once every 15 seconds.

Name: Calculated Ambush
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 20% and the damage by 20%.

Name: Cat-a-clysmic Entrance
Description: Casting Searing Pain now grants you Cat-a-Clysmic Entrance for 10 sec. While at 5 stacks your next Cat Form shapeshift has no global cooldown and unleashes Cat-a-clysm.    Cat-a-clysm Deals 53 Fire damage to 6 enemies within 8 yards, increasing your Fire damage dealt to them by 20% for 10 sec.

Name: Cataclysmic Power
Description: This spell belongs to Pyromancer    The damage of Fireball and Incinerate is increased by 2% for each of your Fire periodic effects on the target.

Name: Cataclysmic Sundering
Description: Sundering leaves a burning patch on the ground for 8 sec. Dealing 118 Fire damage to enemies every second and increasing the damage of your Flame shock by 50%.

Name: Celestial Fury
Description: Critical strikes with Wrath while Nature's Grace is active grant you Celestial Fury.   Celestial Fury Your next direct Arcane spell deals 5, increased by 20% per stack, additional Arcane damage to nearby enemies. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Celestial Replenishment
Description: Triggering an Eclipse now restores 16% of your missing mana.

Name: Centered
Description: Your direct Holy heals now grant you Centered.    Centered Your Smite, Holy Fire, and Penance deal 4% increased damage and have 5% increased chance to hit. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Chaos Manifesting
Description: After casting Chaos Bolt, you receive a Fire or Shadow Empowerment, increasing your damage dealt with that school by 10% for 8 sec.

Name: Charged Ice
Description: Consuming Fingers of Frost with Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt, Ice Lance or Deep Freeze grants Charged Ice.      Charged Ice Increases the damage of Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Thunderstorm and Lava Burst by 40%. Stacks up to 2. Lasts 7 sec. The duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Charged Thunder
Description: Stormstrike now refunds all charges of your Lightning Shield.

Name: Charged Tides
Description: Casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or triggering Lightning Rod grants you Charged Tides.      Charged Tides Your next Chain Heal or Healing Wave deals 10% increased healing and has a 25% reduced cast time. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Chasing the Flames
Description: Dealing damage with Flametongue Weapon reduces the active cooldown of Immolation and Explosive Trap by 3 seconds.

Name: Chilling Blows
Description: Your Frostbrand hits extend the duration of your Deep Freeze by 0.3 seconds or reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds against enemies permanently immune to stuns.    Dealing damage with Deep Freeze increases your attack speed by 15% for 8 sec.

Name: Clad in Frost
Description: Requires Frost Presence or Mana-Forged Barrier.    Casting Ice Barrier or Icebound Fortitude now grants you Clad in Frost.    Clad in Frost Reduces all damage taken by 12%, 30% increased threat from Frost sources and increases the chance to trigger Fingers of Frost by 10%. Lasts for 10 sec.    While active, casting a Frost spell reduces the remaining cooldown of Ice Barrier by 1 sec.    While Clad in Frost is active, Frost spell and ability casts reduce the remaining cooldown of Ice Barrier by 1 sec.

Name: Clarity of the Mind
Description: Your Omen of Clarity talent has an additional 4% chance to activate.

Name: Clean Pass
Description: Your Glaive Toss consumes your Piercing Shots bleed to deal its full damage increased by 125%.

Name: Cleanse In Flames
Description: Exorcism, Judgement, Hammer of Wrath and Holy Shock deal 25% increased damage to targets afflicted by your Holy Fire.

Name: Cleansing Flames of the Apostate
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Casting Cauterizing Fire or Pyroblast grants you Flames of the Apostate while in combat.    Dealing direct damage with Pyroblast heals three nearby allies for 534.    Dealing periodic damage with Pyroblast heals one nearby ally for 17.    Flamestrike applies Cauterizing Embers to allies standing within it.    Cauterizing Embers Heals the target for 12 every 2 seconds.    Flames of the Apostate Flamestrike's cast time is reduced by 20% per stack.    At 5 stacks, Flamestrike also grants a shield that absorbs 35 damage on up to 5 allies.

Name: Clear Mind
Description: Your Elemental Focus Clearcasting gains an extra charge, reduces mana cost by an additional 10%, and now grants 5% spell haste.

Name: Cloudburst
Description: Increases the damage of your Thunderstorm by 100%.    The mana restored by your Thunderstom is increased by 100%.    Your Thunderstorm gains, or increases its cast time by 1 second.

Name: Coagulation
Description: Blood Horror's damage is increased by 50%, healing by 125%, and you take 30% less damage.

Name: Cobra Combo
Description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to increase your Tamed Pet's critical strike chance by 15% for 12 sec.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Cold Dark Thoughts
Description: Dealing direct Frost damage has a 15% chance to grant you Mindblast!.   Mindblast! Your next Mind Blast spell is instant, costs no mana, deals 25% more damage. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Cold Seeking Missiles
Description: Dealing damage with Frostbolt increases the damage the target takes from your Arcane Missiles by 10%.

Name: Coldshot
Description: Hunter shots reduce the cast time of your next Ray of Frost by 15%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec.

Name: Coldstrike Marksmanship
Description: Direct Frost Spell critical strikes grant you a charge of Coldstrike Marksmanship.    Coldstrike Marksmanship Increases the damage of your next Hunter Shot by 20%. Holds 6 charges. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Collective Conscious
Description: Your Tranquility also restores 15% base mana when it heals.

Name: Combat Medic
Description: Your Bandage now grows more effective with each heal, increasing the healing your ally receives from Bandage by 15%, stacks up to 8 times.

Name: Combusting Shots
Description: Direct Fire spell damage while Combustion is active grants Combusting Shots. Subsequent casts increase the duration by 3 seconds.   Combusting Shots Increases the damage done by Explosive Shot by 20%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

Name: Compound Power
Description: Your damaging Steady Shot and Arcane Shot now award 2 combo points.

Name: Compound Speed
Description: Slice and Dice also increases your Ranged Attack Speed by 30%.

Name: Conductive Affliction
Description: Dealing damage with Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning applies Conductive Affliction to the target for 15 sec. Holds up to 10 charges. Damage from your Unstable Affliction or Vampiric Touch consumes a charge to deal 35% increased damage.

Name: Conductive Venom
Description: Dealing damage with Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning applies Conductive Venom for 15 sec, increasing the damage the target takes from your Serpent Sting by 5%. Stacks up to 10 times.

Name: Conductor
Description: Casting Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt and Frost Nova grants Conductor.      Conductor Your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or Lava Burst has 34% reduced cast time. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Consecrated Target
Description: Dealing damage with ranged abilities marks the target for 15 sec, increasing the damage it takes from your Holy Fire by 5%. Stacks up to 10 times.

Name: Consecrated Zeal
Description: Dealing damage with Consecration grants you a stack of Consecrated Zeal.    Consecrated Zeal Increases holy damage done by 1% and reduces physical damage taken by 1%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 3 sec.

Name: Conservation
Description: Effective direct heals grant you Conservation.    Conservation Increases your mana regeneration by 1, increasing with level, and allows 10% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting for 6 sec.    Stacks up to 5 times.

Name: Consumed By Shadows
Description: Requires  Shadowform    After exiting Stealth you will enter Shadowform.

Name: Consuming Flames
Description: Increases the potency of your Ignite talent by an additional 15%, but your Fire critical strikes deal 5% less damage.

Name: Controlled Burn
Description: Chaos Bolt extends the duration of your Immolate by 6 sec. Your Immolate periodic critical strikes also trigger Ignite.

Name: Controlled Chaos
Description: Spells with a cast time reduce the cooldown of Chaos Bolt by 2 seconds.

Name: Corrupted Bear Form
Description: Corrupts your Bear Form, causing your melee attacks to deal additional high-threat Shadow damage while reducing Physical damage dealt by 20%.

Name: Corrupted Blade
Description: Your Sinister Strike and Gloomblade casts spread your Corruption to enemies within 10 yards of the target.    Corruption will not spread to crowd controlled players or totems.

Name: Corrupted Shiv
Description: Dealing damage with Shiv now applies Corruption and refreshes Shadow Word: Pain.

Name: Corrupting Shadows
Description: Your Shadowburn applies Corruption to the target.

Name: Counterpoise
Description: While above 50% rage, you gain 5% melee haste. While below 50% rage, you gain 3% melee critical strike chance.

Name: Courage of Elune
Description: Your Maul, Swipe, and Mangle (Bear) have a chance to grant party members 2% Strength for 10 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Covering Crown
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Casting Rejuvenation now grants your target Covering Crown.    Covering Crown Reduces the damage taken from area of effect attacks by 30% for 3 sec. This does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Coward's Bane
Description: Your Warrior abilities have a chance to daze enemies facing away from you for 3 seconds.

Name: Crackling Thunder
Description: Thunder Clap creates Crackling Thunder on the ground, dealing 3 Nature damage and increasing your critical strike chance against nearby enemies by 5%.     This damage generates additional threat.

Name: Crazy Cultist
Description: Your offensive Warlock spell casts have a 25% chance to cast an additional random Warlock spell for free.

Name: Creeping Frost
Description: Your Deep Freeze now spawns creeping frost beneath the target that grows in size every second and reduces enemy movement speed by 40%.

Name: Crimson Claws
Description: Dealing damage with Crimson Tempest has a 20% chance per combo point to send your Tamed Pet into a frenzy, causing its auto attacks to hit 5 nearby enemies for 8 sec.    This effect can only occur once every 15 sec.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin or Tether Elemental, and Tame Beast.      Crimson Claws Auto attacks strike 5 nearby enemy targets for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Crimson Defense
Description: Blocking now grants you Crimson Defender.      Crimson Defender Crimson Defender stacks up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, your next listed spell consumes the stacks:    - Shield Slam and Shield of Righteousness: Deals an additional 34 Holy damage to the target.    - Judgement: Hits 4 additional nearby targets.    - Power Word: Shield: Reduces your damage taken by 15% for 5 seconds.

Name: Crimson Ward
Description: Rune Strike hits reduce the remaining cooldown of Vampiric Blood by 2 sec.    Parrying attacks also reduces the remaining cooldown of Vampiric Blood by 2 sec. This effect can only occur once every 5 sec.

Name: Critical Cycles
Description: Solar Eclipse now increases your periodic Nature damage by 60%.    Lunar Eclipse now increases your periodic Arcane damage by 60%.

Name: Critical Serration
Description: Unlocked by  Piercing Shots (Rank 1)  Shuriken Toss and Deadly Throw criticals can now trigger your Piercing Shots talent.

Name: Critical Time
Description: Your spells now have a 5% increased chance to critically strike against targets affected by your Living Bomb.    Living Bomb Explosion now applies Chain Reaction to all targets hit.      Chain Reaction Increases the damage taken by the final explosion of Living bomb by 50%. Stacks up to 10 times. Lasts 3 sec.

Name: Crushing Charge
Description: Hitting targets affected by your Crushing Impact with Physical melee abilities now reduces the cooldown of Battle Charge by 3 seconds.    This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Name: Crushing Impact
Description: Charge now applies Crushing Impact to all enemies within 10 yards.    Crushing Impact Increases the damage taken from the caster by 10% and Victory Rush by 40% for 12 sec.

Name: Cryotherapist
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Dealing damage with Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt, or Ice Lance triggers a heal on a nearby ally for 41.    Dealing damage with Deep Freeze triggers a heal on 5 nearby allies for 231 and applies Cryotherapy to them.    Dealing damage with Icy Penance triggers a heal on 3 nearby allies for 257.    Heals from Cryotherapist benefit from healing modifiers and can trigger additional effects.    Ranks 1-3 of Frostbolt trigger a lesser version of the heal.      Cryotherapy Restore 59 each 2 second for 10 sec

Name: Cursed Arrows
Description: Ranged auto attacks have a 10% chance to curse the target, when that target dies it summons a skeletal guardian to fight for you.

Name: Dancer in the Dark
Description: While in Stealth, Shadow Dance cooldown recovery is doubled.

Name: Dark Arrows
Description: Dealing damage with Shadow Bolt or Seed of Corruption now grants you Dark Arrows.    Each Dark Arrow fired reduces the remaining cooldown of Black Arrow by 1 sec.    Dark Arrows Your next 5 Auto Shots fire a Dark Arrow dealing 100% ranged weapon damage as Shadow and restoring 2% of your maximum mana. Lasts 15 seconds.

Name: Dark Intent
Description: Dealing damage with Sinister Strike, Eviscerate, Garrote, Rupture, Crimson Tempest, Shiv, Ambush and Gloomblade now deals 10 additional Shadow damage.  If the ability critically strikes, the additional Shadow damage is also a critical hit.

Name: Dark Justicar
Description: Holy Vengeance and Ebon Corruption now stack up to 10. At 10 stacks, neither damage over time effect can be refreshed.    Your Judgements and Scourge Strike can consume 10 stacks of its damage over time effect to deal 19 additional Holy damage. Consuming 10 stacks also increases your damage dealt by 10% for 10 sec.

Name: Dark Reclamation
Description: Dealing damage with Drain Soul or casting Life Tap grants you Dark Reclamation.      Dark Reclamation Reduces the cooldown of your next Shadowburn by 1 seconds.   Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Dark Surgeon
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Rogue finishing moves apply Surgical Treatment per combo point spent.    Premeditation now grants 1 additional combo point and can be used out of stealth.    Surgical Treatment Heals each second for 53. Lasts 6 sec.

Name: Dark Winter
Description: Dealing damage with Frost spells now applies Dark Winter.    Dark Winter Increases your periodic shadow damage dealt to the target by 2%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Darkwing Volley
Description: Dealing damage with Black Arrow reduces the remaining cooldown of Summon Gargoyle by 3 sec.

Name: Darting Shadows
Description: Increases your movement speed by 70% for 4 sec after using Vanish.

Name: Dawning Light
Description: Your Holy Shock healing is now increased by 50% on allies below 50% health.

Name: Deadly Aim
Description: Your ranged auto shots now have a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Aimed Shot and increase its damage by 15% for 6 sec.

Name: Deadly Bite
Description: Dealing damage with Mongoose Bite, Counterattack or Savage Blade applies Deadly Bite for 12 sec, causing 40% of the triggering damage as Bleed damage over its duration.    Repeated applications accumulate into the existing bleed and refresh its duration.      Deadly Bite Bleeding for accumulated damage equal to 40% of the triggering Mongoose Bite, Counterattack or Savage Blade damage over 12 sec. Reapplying Deadly Bite adds the new damage to the remaining bleed and refreshes the duration.

Name: Deadly Combo
Description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Sudden Death.      Sudden Death You may use Execute regardless of target's health.

Name: Deadly Instinct
Description: Dealing damage with Savage Blade now grants you Deadly Instinct.     Deadly Instinct Increases the damage of your Counterattack and Mongoose Bite by 50% against monsters.  This has 5 charges and lasts 15 sec.    Counterattack and Mongoose Bite deal 35% increased damage against players.

Name: Deadly Leap
Description: Heroic Leap now deals 25% increased damage. If Heroic Leap kills an enemy the cooldown is reset.

Name: Death or Glory
Description: Last Stand now dispels all harmful magic effects on you and boosts your melee attack power, speed, and movement by 10% for 10 seconds.

Name: Deathbringer
Description: Dealing damage with single-target spells and abilities deals an additional 7 Shadow damage.    This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Name: Debilitating Roar
Description: The cooldown of your Challenging Roar and Challenging Shout is reduced by 12 sec and their duration is increased by 1 sec.    Your Challenging Roar and Challenging Shout also reduce affected enemies' damage done by 15%.

Name: Decimation by Pyro
Description: Your Decimation also increases the damage of your Pyroblast and Meteor by 25%.

Name: Defense of Thundarian
Description: Dealing damage with Windfury now grants you Cloaked in Wind.    Cloaked in Wind Reduces your magic damage taken by 2% and increases your armor by 3%. Lasts 6 sec. Stacks up to 2 times.

Name: Defias Gunslinger
Description: Requires  Duelist's Glove  A Duelist's Glove is an off-hand item that enables Swashbuckling. It is granted whenever you learn a talent or ability that requires it.    Sinister Strike now grants you Gunslinger's Strike.    Gunslinger's Strike Increases the damage of your next Raptor Strike by 50%. Lasts 12 sec.    Damage increased by 30% against players.

Name: Defias Tactics
Description: Using Sinister Strike and Multi-Shot now reduce the active cooldown of your Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite by 2 second.

Name: Defile the Grove
Description: Your Druid periodic damage deals 8% increased damage to targets standing in your Death and Decay.

Name: Demolisher
Description: Your Mortal Strike now applies Demolish.    Demolish Increases your physical damage dealt to the target by 2%. Your melee critical strikes add an additional stack. Upon reaching 6 stacks your next melee critical strike consumes them. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Demonic Burst
Description: Your Demonic Leap now sends out a Blast Wave, dealing 40% increased damage while this talent is active, knocking enemies back, and granting you Bursting Power.   Bursting Power Increases your damage done by 5%. Lasts 3 sec.

Name: Demonic Deception
Description: Reduces threat causes by your summoned demon by 30%. This enchant does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Demonic Influence
Description: While in Metamorphosis your Summoned Demon, Demon and Wild Imps gain Demonic Influence.      Demonic Influence Damage increased by 30% and regenerates 500 mana every 5 seconds. Benefits Wild Imps.

Name: Demonic Persistence
Description: Your Wild Imps from Hand of Gul'dan are now overcharged with Fel energy, causing them to deteriorate over time. This causes your Incinerate and Mind Blast to trigger Demonic Persistence.    Demonic Persistence Sacrifices the lowest-health Wild Imp, dealing 140 to 180 Fire damage to targets within 8 yards. Increases the damage of your active Demon by 20% and your Wild Imps by 20%, stacking up to 4 times. For each demon detonated, your Wild Imps last 1 additional second per stack of Demonic Persistence.  Requires a Demon

Name: Demonic Reoccurence
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Metamorphosis by 50%. Metamorphosis grants 90% less bonus armor and no longer reduces your chance to be critically hit or the duration of stuns and snares.  Reduces the bonus damage by 10% against players.

Name: Demonic Synergy
Description: Critically striking with a direct damage spell increases your Wild Imps and Summoned Demon's critical chance by 30%. This effect is consumed on your pet's next critical hit.

Name: Deranged Druid
Description: Your offensive Druid spell casts & Feral abilities have a 25% chance to cast an additional random Druid spell for free.

Name: Desperation
Description: Bloodthirst now deals an additional strike dealing up to 45% damage against monsters based on your missing health. This bonus remains up to 33% against players.

Name: Destructive Bargain
Description: Each cast of Incinerate or Soul Fire empowers your Incinerate, Soul Fire and Beam of Hatred:   - Increasing the damage dealt against monsters by 8%   - Reducing the casting speed by 3%   - Reducing the global cooldown by 5%   - Increasing the mana cost by 40%    These effects stack up to 5 times and last 9 sec.

Name: Deter and Punish
Description: Your Deterrence also reflects spells and retaliates against attacks.

Name: Devil's Claws
Description: You now gain 7 seconds of Devil's Claws when casting Searing Pain or Cat-a-clysm and 15 seconds when casting Berserk.    Devil's Claws Claw, Shred, Ravage and Mangle deal additional Fire damage, cost 15 less energy, and restore 7% of your mana.

Name: Devouring
Description: Applying Warlock and Death Knight damage over time effects refreshes your Devouring Plague's duration on the target.

Name: Direct Command
Description: Increases the damage of your Seal of Command by 35% against monsters and 20% against players, but it now only hits 1 additional target.

Name: Disciple of the Tides
Description: Direct Nature critical heals now grant you Disciple of the Tides.    Disciple of the Tides Increases the damage or healing of your next Penance by 20%.     Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 20 sec.

Name: Divine Circle
Description: Your Flash Heal and Greater Heal now grant you Empowered Circle of Healing    Empowered Circle of Healing Increases the effect of your next Circle of Healing by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Divine Concord
Description: The Art of War now makes Arcane Blast instant.    When Arcane Blast consumes The Art of War, it grants one additional Arcane Blast stack. While Harnessed Energy is active, it grants one additional Harnessed Energy charge instead.

Name: Divine Efficiency
Description: The mana cost of Greater Heal is reduced by 25%.

Name: Divine Ferocity
Description: Mongoose Bite and Counterattack increase the damage of your next Divine Storm by 50%. Stacks up to 5 times.

Name: Divine Guidance
Description: Dealing damage with Penance now grants you Divine Guidance.    Divine Guidance Your next healing Penance deals 40% increased healing and causes each bolt to radiate outward, healing 5 nearby allies for 5 and reducing the cooldown of Penance by 1 second.

Name: Divine Judgement
Description: Healing with Penance now grants you Divine Judgement.    Divine Judgement Your next damaging Penance deals 100% increased damage and causes each bolt to explode, dealing 9 additional Holy damage to 5 nearby enemies and reducing the cooldown of Penance by 1 second.  Penance deals 75% increased damage against players.

Name: Divine Prophet
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Blast, Arcane Missiles and Arcane Barrage now grant you Divine Wrath.    Divine Wrath Increases the damage of your next Smite or Holy Fire by 25%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Divine Reset
Description: Direct damaging Holy spells and abilities have a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Divine Storm.

Name: Dominant Word: Shield
Description: Your Power Word: Shield now absorbs for an additional 75% when cast on allies below 75% health.    Damaging casts of Smite, Holy Fire, and Penance now grant a stack of Dominant Shield.    Dominant Shield stacks can only be obtained from Penance every 2 seconds.    Dominant Shield Increases the amount absorbed by your next Power Word: Shield by 20%, but reduces its duration by 1 sec. Stacks up to 10 times. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Doomhammer's Fury
Description: Casting Lava Lash now grants you Doomhammer's Fury.    Doomhammer's Fury Your Pyroblast and Lava Burst now restore mana, generate a stack of Maelstrom Weapon, and deal 13% increased direct damage. Lasts for 8 sec.

Name: Doppelganger
Description: Your Vanish now spawns a Doppelganger that looks like you and runs in a random direction, taking the hits so you can get away. Lasts 4 sec.

Name: Double Down
Description: Your Sinister Strike and its Classless transforms, including Thrust and Eclipse Strike, also strike with your off-hand weapon, but no longer generate combo points.

Name: Double Team
Description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Double Team.      Double Team Increases your Tamed Beast's special attack damage by 80% against monsters or 40 to 39% against players. Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Double-clawed
Description: Increases the periodic damage of Rip and Rake by 60% and their duration by 3 sec.

Name: Down For The Count
Description: Your Killing Spree hits cause an additional strike for 25% of the damage dealt against monsters when attacking a bleeding or poisoned enemy. This strike deals 15% against players.

Name: Draconic Might
Description: Casting Charge, Intercept, Feral Charge, and Dragon Roar now grants you Draconic Might.    Draconic Might Increases melee and ranged critical strike chance and haste by 5%. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Draconic Slam
Description: Dealing damage with Bloodthirst and Execute grants you Draconic Slam.    Draconic Slam Your next Slam is instant and deals 50% increased damage. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Dragon Warrior
Description: Casting Slam now grants you Dragon Fury.     Dragon Fury Reduces the cooldown of your next Dragon Roar by 5 seconds and increases its damage done by 20%. Stacks up to 3 times.    At max stacks, Dragon Roar stuns enemies for 2 seconds.

Name: Draining Strikes
Description: Dealing damage with single target spells and abilities have a chance to heal you for 3.    This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Name: Dreadnaught
Description: Dealing damage with Overpower, Slam and Rune Strike now unleashes a wave of force in front of you dealing 9 Physical damage to 6 targets in front of you.    This effect can only occur once every 4 sec.

Name: Druid of the Flame
Description: Your Claw, Mangle, Shred and Ravage deal 10% increased damage against targets affected by your Ignite.

Name: Druidic Storm
Description: While Nature's Grace is active, the damage of Chain Lightning, Lightning Bolt and Earth Shock is increased by 35%. Nature's Grace lasts 2 seconds longer.

Name: Duck Hunting
Description: Your damaging abilities and Auto Shots against enemies 5 yards above you now dispel Slow Fall and deal an additional strike for 3% of the original damage.

Name: Duelist
Description: Using Taunt on a player now plants a dueling flag at their location, reducing their movement speed by 30% for 6 sec if they flee the area.

Name: Dusk Till Dawn
Description: Damaging spells with a cast time grant you Dusk Till Dawn.    Dusk Till Dawn Increases the damage of your next Shadowburn by 10%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 15 sec.    When used at 5 stacks, Shadowburn will hit 5 additional targets.

Name: Earth's Blessing
Description: Direct healing an ally affected by your Earth Shield restores two Earth Shield charges and grants them Earth's Blessing.    Earth's Blessing Increases your chance to critically heal the target by 5%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Eccentric Elementalist
Description: Your offensive Shaman spell casts have a 25% chance to cast an additional random Shaman spell for free.

Name: Echoed Incinerate
Description: Casting Incinerate has a 30% chance to trigger Echoed Incinerate.       Echoed Incinerate Deals -13 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25 to 29 Fire damage if the target is affected by an Immolate spell.    Scales with Incinerate modifiers.

Name: Echoing Power
Description: Your Shaman Shock spells grant you a boon:    Earth Shock: Reduces your Physical damage taken by 4% and increases threat generated from Nature sources by 8%.    Frost Shock: Reduces the target's attack power by 2, reduces your damage taken by 2%, and increases threat generated from Frost sources by 8%.    Flame Shock: Grants you a shield that deals Fire damage to melee attackers, reduces your magic damage taken by 3%, and increases threat generated from Fire sources by 8%.    Attack power reduction does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Eclipse Bomber
Description: When you gain Eclipse (Solar) you also gain Solar Bomber, causing your Fireball and Pyroblast to grant you Lunar Flames.    When you gain Eclipse (Lunar) you also gain Lunar Bomber, causing your Starfire and Starsurge to grant you Solar Flames.      Lunar Flames Increases the damage of your Starfire and Starsurge by 14%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 18 sec or until you gain Eclipse (Solar).    Solar Flames Increases the damage of Fireball and Pyroblast by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 18 sec or until you gain Eclipse (Lunar).

Name: Edge of Fury
