Description: Your direct Holy healing spells reduce the cooldown of Lightwell by 4 seconds.

Name: Rejuvenating Swiftness
Description: Your Swiftmend casts now increase the healing of your Rejuvenations by 40% for 10 sec.    Your Swiftmend now reduces the cooldown of your Spirit of the Forest by 5 sec.

Name: Relentless Laceration
Description: Your Lacerate can stack 3 additional times, and its damage over time effect now benefits from melee haste.

Name: Relentless Reflexes
Description: Your finishing moves grant Relentless Reflexes, increasing dodge chance by 4% per stack. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 16 sec.    The duration is not refreshed when gaining stacks.

Name: Remorseless Execution
Description: Dealing damage with Execute now grants you Remorseless.    Remorseless Increases the critical strike chance for your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Mutilate, Ambush, Hemorrhage, or Ghostly strike by 20%.

Name: Renewed Energy
Description: Restores 20% base mana when you kill a target that gives experience or honor. This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.  This enchant does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Renewed Through Absolution
Description: Penance now consumes your Renew to heal your target for an additional 184.  This heal uses Penance heal modifiers.

Name: Renewing Light
Description: Healing with Renew grants you a stack of Renewing Light.      Renewing Light Increases the healing done by your next Circle of Healing by 3%. Stacks 30 times and lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Repartee
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Feint by 4 seconds, and Feint enables the use of Riposte for 6 sec.

Name: Repentant Reconciliation
Description: Damaging Penance missiles now radiate a Circle of Reconciliation upon impact.      Circle of Reconciliation Heals 5 allies within 15 yards of the target for 5.    This healing effect uses Circle of Healing modifiers and scales from your Holy or Nature healing power, whichever is strongest.

Name: Reproachful Revenge
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Revenge by 15%.

Name: Revengeful Sentinel
Description: Shield Slam increases the damage of your next Revenge by 20%. Revenge cast this way reduces the remaining cooldown of Shield Wall by 5 sec.

Name: Righteous Abjuration
Description: Your Shield of Righteousness now reduces the cooldown of your Ward spells by 2 seconds.

Name: Righteous Fire
Description: Increases the damage over time effect of your Holy Fire ability by 150% and increases its duration by 3.0 sec.

Name: Righteous Opportunity
Description: Dealing direct damage with spells and abilities has a 20% chance to grant you Righteous Opportunity.      Righteous Opportunity Your next Hammer of Wrath may be used regardless of the target's health. Lasts 6 sec.

Name: Righteous Radiance
Description: Using direct damage Fire spells and abilities now grants you Righteous Radiance and increases the duration of Holy Fire on the target by 1 second.      Righteous Radiance Increases the direct damage of your next Holy Fire by 15%.    At 5 stacks, your Holy Fire hits 5 additional targets and triggers your Ignite talent.

Name: Righteous Zealot
Description: Your direct damaging spells and abilities now have a 30% chance to Smite your target, dealing 17 additional Holy damage and healing nearby party members for 23.    This damage uses Smite modifiers and can only occur once every 4.5 sec. Deals 80% damage and healing when triggered against enemy players.

Name: Rimebound Shadow
Description: Your Frost spell or ability damage against targets affected by your Frost Fever has a 25% chance to grant Rimebound Shadow. Your Frost Fever deals 100% increased periodic damage and can critically strike.    Rimebound Shadow Your next Grave Coil triggers 36 Shadowfrost damage around the target.  This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Name: Ripping Tempest
Description: Increases the duration of Crimson Tempest by 4 seconds, and its damage by 40%.

Name: Rising Winds
Description: Windfury weapon deals 50% increased damage against monsters.    Using Whirlwind shortly after Stormstrike makes your next Windfury Weapon not trigger its cooldown.

Name: Rising Wrath
Description: Casting Wrath while in Cat Form now awards 2 combo points

Name: Rocket-fueled Fins
Description: Increases the swim speed of your Aquatic Form by 25%.

Name: Rooted in Storm
Description: Effective direct heals reduce the cooldown of Living Lightning by 2 seconds.

Name: Roots of The Forest
Description: Your Treants now prioritize target afflicted with Entangling Roots.

Name: Rune-etched Bullets
Description: Your Hunter shots have a 33% chance to grant Rune-etched Bullets.      Rune-etched Bullets Your next Arcane Blast is instant.

Name: Runeblade Reflection
Description: Your Blood Strike, Heart Strike, Rune Strike, Death Strike, and Obliterate hits reduce the remaining cooldown of Dancing Rune Weapon by 1 sec.

Name: Runeforged Verdict
Description: Your Judgements against a target affected by your Frost Fever or Blood Plague extend those diseases by 2 sec, up to 6 sec beyond their normal maximum, and grant Runeforged Verdict.    Runeforged Verdict Your next Frost Strike, Heart Strike, or Obliterate deals 30% increased direct damage and costs no resources.

Name: Runic Contagion
Description: Whenever your Frost Fever or Blood Plague causes damage, you have a 10% chance to allow you to use Rune Strike for 9 sec.    This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Name: Runic Defense
Description: When you dodge, parry, or block, you have a 15% chance to activate and convert a Rune into a Death Rune for 10 seconds. This chance is doubled while Bone Shield is active.    Dodging or parrying also makes your next Death Strike within 10 sec cost no runes.    This effect can only occur once every 15 sec.

Name: Runic Maelstrom
Description: When you consume Maelstrom Weapon at maximum stacks, your next Rune Strike, Heart Strike, Frost Strike, or Obliterate deals 75% increased damage.

Name: Rush of Blood
Description: Dealing damage with Hemorrhage has a 50% chance to grant Rush of Blood.    Rush of Blood Your next Ambush can be cast outside of stealth and has no positional requirement versus monsters. Lasts 12 sec.

Name: Sacred Conduction
Description: Dealing direct or periodic damage with Holy Fire grants Sacred Conduction, increasing the damage of Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 5% per stack for 10 sec. Stacks up to 15 times.     Getting stacks does not refresh the duration.

Name: Sanguine Pressure
Description: Blood Boil grants Sanguine Pressure.      Sanguine Pressure Increases your Physical damage done to bleeding enemies by 3%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Sanguine Strikes
Description: Dealing periodic damage with Rend, Crimson Tempest, Garrote or Rupture grants you Sanguine Strikes.    Sanguine Strikes Your next Hemorrhage deals 30% increased damage. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 4 sec.

Name: Saronite Phalanx
Description: Bone Shield holds 1 more charge.     Dodging, parrying, or blocking while Bone Shield is active restores a charge and grant Saronite Phalanx       Saronite Phalanx Increases the damage of your next Rune Strike, Shield Slam or Shield of Righteousness by 50%. Stacks up to 3. Lasts 12 seconds.    This can occur only once every 5 seconds

Name: Savage Synergy
Description: The duration of your Tiger's Fury is 2 seconds longer.    While in Cat Form, using Bloodthirst now awards 2 combo points.

Name: Savage Wounds
Description: Maim marks the target to take 15% increased damage from your Bleed effects and has its duration increased by 1 seconds.

Name: Savagery
Description: Your Wing Clip now deals 40% more damage and reduces the cooldown of your Mongoose Bite by 1 second.

Name: Sawed Off Barrel
Description: Your Multi-shot knocks your primary target back, or knocks you back when fired in the air. Multi-shot's range is reduced by 15 yards and the cooldown is doubled.

Name: Say Your Prayers
Description: Prayer of Mending has a 35% chance not to consume a charge when it jumps to a new target.    The last charge of Prayer of Mending heals for 150% more.

Name: Scattered Burst
Description: Your Scatter Shot releases a fiery cone, dealing 6 Fire damage, knocking enemies back, and causing them take 10% increased damage from you for 6 sec.

Name: Scorched Ground
Description: Living Bomb explosion triggers Flamestrike    This effect can only occur once every 8 sec.

Name: Scourging Instinct
Description: Your Mongoose Bite, Raptor Strike, Blood Plague, Frost Fever, and Unholy Blight damage each have a 20% chance to grant Scourging Instinct.    Scourging Instinct causes your next Scourge Strike to consume no runes and deal 50% increased damage.

Name: Searing Rage
Description: When your Searing Totem deals damage, you are granted Searing Rage and gain 5 rage.    Searing Rage At 5 stacks, your next Lava Lash deals 25% increased damage.

Name: Second Sunrise
Description: Critically healing with a direct spell now reduces the active cooldown of Light of Dawn by 5 seconds.    Penance can only trigger Second Sunrise once every 1 sec.

Name: Seed of Life
Description: Healing with Regrowth and Rejuvenation now plants a Seed of Life on allies.    Seed of Life Heals 3 every second and increases the healing of your Bloom on the target by 40%. Stacks up to 8 times and lasts for 10 sec.

Name: Seeded Shield
Description: The periodic heal of your Regrowth can now critically hit and benefits from Haste.

Name: Seismic Shockwave
Description: Your melee abilities grant you Seismic Shockwave.    Seismic Shockwave Increases the damage of your next Shockwave by 15%. At 3 stacks, Shockwave's range is increased by 5 yards and stuns for an additional second. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Serenity
Description: Increases the duration of your Tranquility by 4 sec and its mana cost by 15%.

Name: Servant of the Old Gods
Description: Casting Gloomblade forces your Tentacles of the Old Gods to smash towards your target, dealing 27 Shadow damage.     This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Name: Shadow Born
Description: Dealing critical damage with Corruption and Unstable Affliction grant you Shadow Born.       Shadow Born Increases the direct damage of your next Shadowburn by 25%, and by an additional 15% against monsters. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Shadow Core
Description: Requires  Molten Core (Rank 3)  Casting Mind Blast grants a single charge of Molten Core.

Name: Shadow Crash
Description: While Pure Shadow is at max stacks, your Shadowfury calls down Pure Shadow at the target area, dealing 429 Shadow damage spread between enemies in the area.    Each enemy hit by Shadow Crash will be made vulnerable increasing the damage they take from the caster's Shadow Bolt, Shadow Burn and Chaos Bolt by 10%.

Name: Shadow Infusion
Description: Using Shiv or Death and Decay now grants you Shadow Infusion.    Shadow Infusion Increases the Shadow damage that target takes from you by 12% for 4 sec.

Name: Shadow of Death
Description: Casting Shadowstep now empowers your next Ambush or Ravage, causing them to deal an additional 75% as Shadow damage.

Name: Shadow Strikes
Description: Your damaging Melee and Ranged abilities now have a 15% chance to grant you Shadow Trance.      Shadow Trance Your next Shadow Bolt or Seed of Corruption is instant and costs 25% less mana.

Name: Shadow Visions
Description: Dealing damage with Mind Flay now grants you a Soul Fragment. After accumulating 6 fragments you gain Shadow Visions.      Shadow Visions Empowers your next ability:  - Devouring Plague: Lasts for 12 more seconds, and causes a shadowy explosion.  - Vampiric Touch: Causes you to deal 20% increased Shadow damage to the target for 15 sec.  - Mind Blast: Deals 50% increased damage and grants you Psychic Surge, increasing the damage of Mind Flay and Mind Sear by 25%. This bonus is reduced by 1% for each time they deal damage.

Name: Shadow Word: Helpless Death
Description: Dealing damage with Shadow Word: Death now negates incoming heals to the target equal to the Shadow Word: Death dealt.

Name: Shaken
Description: Casting Fear causes your target to become Shaken.      Shaken All stats are reduced by 5% and movement speed is reduced by 25%. Every 3 sec, nearby enemies become Shaken. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Shapeshift Specialist
Description: Shapeshifting cost is reduced by 20%.

Name: Shapeshifter's Aim
Description: Using Mangle grants you Shapeshifter's Aim.      Shapeshifter's Aim Increases the damage of your hunter shots by 30%. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Shapeshifter's Fangs
Description: Hunter shots grant you Shapeshifter's Fangs.    Shapeshifter's Fangs Damage of your next direct Cat ability is increased by 50%. Max 3 charges. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Sharpened Blade
Description: Dealing damage with Deadly Bite now has a 50% chance to grant you Sharpened Blade.      Sharpened Blade Reduces the active cooldown of Savage Blade and Glaive Toss by 2 sec and increases the damage of your next Savage Blade by 15% against monsters. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 12 sec.    Savage Blade deals 10% increased damage against players.

Name: Shattering Rime
Description: Your Howling Blast deals 30% increased damage.  Obliterate empowers your next Howling Blast to deal 100% increased damage.

Name: Shield Finesse
Description: Using Shield Wall now resets the cooldown of Shield Block.    Using Shield Block now resets the cooldown of Shield Slam.

Name: Shield of the Emperor
Description: Your Shield Slam and Shield of Righteousness now have a 25% chance to grant a stack of Shield of the Emperor, and extend the duration of Avatar by 4 sec if it is active.    Shield of the Emperor Increases the duration of your next Avatar by 3 seconds. Stacks up to 5. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Shield of Wrath
Description: Your Avenger's Shield cooldown is reduced by 40%, but it no longer slows enemies or jumps to additional targets.  Does not work with Shield of the Templar.

Name: Shields of Dominance
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Power Word: Shield by 3 seconds.

Name: Shieldsmasher
Description: Your Counterattack, Savage Blade and Execute grant you Shield Smasher.    Shieldsmasher Increases the damage of your next Colossus Smash by 65% and extends its duration by 3 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts for 20 sec.    Increases damage versus players by 10%.

Name: Shooting Stars
Description: While Starfall is active, the duration is increased by half of the cast time of your Spells.    Channeled spells do not extend the duration.

Name: Shot Weaving
Description: Casting Arcane Missiles while Missile Barrage is active weaves shot and spell together, firing a ranged shot with each Arcane Missile, dealing 15 Physical damage.    While in Path of Agility or Duality your Missile Barrage is hastened by 60%.    Gunslinger's Barrage can trigger Piercing Shots (if known).

Name: Shroud of Concealment
Description: Damaging spells with a cast time used from Stealth weave a shroud of concealment around you, causing you to remain in stealth for an additional second.

Name: Shrouded in Shrapnel
Description: Dealing damage with Colossus Smash now increases your armor by 15% for 8 sec and taking damage from Stagger reduces the active cooldown of Colossus Smash by 4 second.

Name: Sindragosa's Ire
Description: Dealing damage with Obliterate, Frost Strike, or Howling Blast grants one charge of Sindragosa's Ire for 30 sec, up to 10 charges.

Name: Sinister Flurry
Description: Your Sinister Strike has a 50% chance to trigger an additional strike, dealing 130% weapon damage and awarding an additional combo point.

Name: Sinister Transfusion
Description: Dealing damage with combo point generating abilities now grants your Tamed Pet Sinister Transfusion.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.    Sinister Transfusion Increases your Tamed Pet's damage by 20% and restores 1% total mana, 10 energy and Focus every 2 sec for 8 sec.

Name: Skeleton King
Description: Death Pact no longer sacrifices its undead minion.    While in Frost Presence, casting Death Pact while Bone Shield is active restores all Bone Shield charges and increases your maximum health by 15%. The maximum health increase lasts until Bone Shield fades.

Name: Skull Crusher
Description: Your Slam reduces the cooldown of Death Wish by 1 second.

Name: Smoldering Companion
Description: Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks now deal Fire damage.    Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks can only be transformed to one damage type at once.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Sniper
Description: Standing still for 3 seconds grants you Sniper.    Sniper Increases the range of your Aimed Shot and Kill Shot by 1 yards and increases their damage dealt by 4%. Moving removes the stacks. Stacks up to 10 times.

Name: Snow Storm
Description: Increases the channel duration of your Blizzard ability by 2 seconds.

Name: Solar Fury
Description: Casting Starfire and Starsurge during Eclipse (Lunar) grants Solar Fury.      Solar Fury During Eclipse (Solar) your next Wrath deals 50% more damage and reduces the cooldown of Eclipse Blast by 1 sec.    Lasts for 20 sec. Can hold up to 5 charges.

Name: Soul Restoration
Description: Casting Holy Light, Greater Heal, Healing Wave, or Healing Touch on an ally reduces the duration of their Weakened Soul by 4 seconds.

Name: Soul Void
Description: Dealing damage with Drain Soul now applies Soul Void. Reaching 10 stacks applies Withered Soul, causing your Drain Life to deal 75% more damage. Lasts 15 sec.     Enemies with Withered Soul do not gain Soul Void.

Name: Soulbender
Description: Dealing damage with Drain Soul or casting Life Tap grants you Soul Energy.    Soul Energy Your next Shadowburn heals nearby allies and converts all Soul Energy into Soul Mending. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 10 sec.    Soul Mending Increases your healing done by 2% per stack of Soul Energy consumed. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Southpaw Strike
Description: Using Bloodthirst, Execute or Rend triggers an instant off-hand attack, dealing 220% weapon damage, and grants you Southpaw.   Southpaw Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25% for 9 sec.    The effect of Southpaw is increased to 50% while only Single-Minded Fury is active. This effect can only occur once every 16 sec and Southpaw cannot be active at the same time as Dominant.

Name: Spartan Smash
Description: Dealing damage with Javelin applies Skewered. Dealing damage with Shield Slam increases Skewered stacks on affected targets.    Skewered Your next Siegebreaker deals 20% increased damage to the target and resets the cooldown of your Javelin. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts for 12 sec.

Name: Spectre
Description: You deal 10% increased periodic damage while stealthed.

Name: Spell Slinger
Description: When Arcane Clearcasting is consumed, an Arcane Burst deals 6 Arcane damage to your target.

Name: Spellstorm
Description: When Missile Barrage is consumed by Arcane Missiles, you gain Arcane Evoked.    When Brain Freeze is consumed by Fireball or Frostfire Bolt, you gain Fire Evoked.      Arcane Evoked Increases the chance to trigger your next Brain Freeze by an additional 80%. Lasts for 10 sec.    Fire Evoked Increases the chance to trigger your next Missile Barrage by an additional 80%. Lasts for 10 sec.

Name: Spirit Frost
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Every other cast of Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt or Ice Lance grants you Spirit Frost.       Spirit Frost Greater Heal reduces its cast time by 100% and Prayer of Healing reduces its cast time by 50%.     Can hold up to 5 charges and lasts 20 sec.

Name: Spirited Penance
Description: Increases the channel time of Penance by 25% to empower it to fire an additional bolt.

Name: Splintered Chaos
Description: Casting Conflagrate now grants you Splintered Chaos    Splintered Chaos Your Chaos Bolt hits 4 additional nearby enemies.

Name: Spot Weakness
Description: Direct damage spell and abilities have a 15% chance to grant you Spot Weakness.      Spot Weakness Allows Kill Shot to be used regardless of the target's health.

Name: Spreading Plague
Description: Dealing damage with Thrash (Bear) now spreads your Infected Blood and Rabies to all nearby enemies.

Name: Spreading Roots
Description: Your Mass Entanglement now spreads to nearby enemies every 3 sec. These roots last 3 sec and also spread to nearby enemies.  An enemy can only be affected by Spreading Roots once every 10 sec.

Name: Spreading Tides
Description: Critically healing your Riptide target with Healing Wave now casts Riptide to a nearby ally within 15 yards. Only casts on effective heals.    Prioritizes your ally with the lowest health and can target the ally being healed to refresh their Riptide.

Name: Stalker of the Frozen Wastes
Description: Ranged Hunter abilities have a 40% chance to reduce the active cooldown of Frozen Orb by 8 sec.  Casting Frozen Orb increases your ranged haste by 30% for 30 sec.

Name: Stay Frosty
Description: Casting damaging spells or dealing damage with Auto Shot increases the chance to trigger Fingers of Frost by 3% for 10 sec or until activated.

Name: Steed of Glory
Description: Your Divine Steed lasts for an additional 3 sec. While active, you become immune to movement impairing effects.    For each unique enemy you pass through with Divine Steed, the duration of your next Avenging Wrath increases by 0.5 second. Up to 10 seconds.

Name: Stellar Amplification
Description: Dealing damage with Starsurge now apply Stellar Amplification.    Stellar Amplification Your next 5 Balance Druid periodic hits deal 45% increased damage.

Name: Storm of Darkness
Description: Each target damaged by Shadowfury reduces the remaining cooldown of Bladestorm by 4 sec.

Name: Stormborn
Description: While Elemental Mastery or Shamanistic Rage is active, dealing damage with Stormstrike now deals an additional 86 Nature damage to all enemies in front of you.

Name: Stormbringer
Description: Your direct damaging spells and abilities now have a chance to unleash lightning, dealing 3 Nature damage to your target and electrifying the ground, dealing an additional 12 Nature damage to nearby enemies every second for 4 seconds.

Name: Stormforged Edge
Description: Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Static Shock and Thunderstorm hits increase the damage of your next Stormstrike by 24%. Stacks up to 8. Lasts 8 sec. Duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Stormgarde
Description: While Lightning Shield is active, your Shield Slam and Shield of Righteousness now unleash Stormgarde.    Stormgarde Zaps your target and 2 nearby enemies for 26 Nature damage and restores your Lightning Shield charges.    This uses Lightning Shield modifiers and can only occur once every 2 sec.

Name: Stupefied
Description: Shield Bash now reduces the enemy's cast speed by 30% for 6 sec.    This effect does not stack with other similar effects

Name: Surging Shadows
Description: Dealing Shadow periodic damage has a 10% chance to grant Surging Shadows, increasing your Lightning Overload chance by 40% for 10 sec.

Name: Swashbuckler: Bloodsail
Description: Requires  Duelist's Glove  A Duelist's Glove is an off-hand item that enables Swashbuckling. It is granted whenever you learn a talent or ability that requires it. Does not work while shapeshifted.      Bloodsail Swashbuckling Your critical strike chance is increased by 3%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 24 sec.

Name: Swift Avenger
Description: Your Avenger's Shield now hits up to 3 additional targets. For each target hit, you gain 10% increased movement speed. Stacks up to 6 times and lasts 4 sec.

Name: Swift Favor
Description: Direct Holy heals reduce the cooldown of Divine Favor by 1 seconds. Effective direct Holy heals reduce this cooldown by an additional 2 seconds.

Name: Swift Justice
Description: When Smite or Flash Heal consumes Surge of Light, you gain Swift Justice.    Swift Justice Increases your haste by 1%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Swift Shadows
Description: Increases the duration of your Shadowstep by 2 seconds.    Ambushing, Deadly Throwing or Ravaging a Shadow Marked target resets the cooldown of your Shadowstep.

Name: Sword and Thunder

Name: Synergetic Light
Description: Holy Light and Flash of Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Shock by 2 seconds.

Name: Tainted Swipe

Name: Talonshrike

Name: Taste of Success
Description: Victory Rush grants you Taste of Success and deals 30% additional damage against monsters or 10% against players.   Taste of Success Your physical damage taken from the next attack is reduced by 60%.

Name: Teachings of Arugal
Description: Shadow spells with a cast time grant you Arugal's Fury and have a 30% chance to grant Missile Barrage. Missile Barrage Reduces the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 2.5 sec, reduces the mana cost by 100%, and the missiles fire every 0.4 sec. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Tempered by Chaos
Description: Consuming Molten Core with Incinerate or Chaos Bolt resets the cooldown of Fel Cleave and increases the damage of your next Fel Cleave by 30%.

Lasts for 3 sec.

Name: Tethered Power

Name: The Shattering
Description: Your Shattering Throw now triggers an Earthquake beneath the enemy for 4 sec.

Name: Thousand Cuts
Description: Dealing damage with Hurricane now increases your Poison and Bleed damage by 7%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Threatening Presence
Description: Increases the threat generated by your physical damage by 40%.  Reduces all damage taken by 2%.

Description: Dealing damage with Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning grant Thunder Seer.     Thunder Seer Increases the damage of the next Arcane Missiles projectile by 40%. Holds up to 25 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Thunder Stomp
Description: Slam and Stormstrike now reduce the active cooldown of Thunder Clap by 2 seconds.

Name: Thunder Swarm
Description: Dealing damage with Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning during Solar Eclipse has a 25% chance to energize your Insect Swarm, triggering an additional tick.

Name: Thunderburst
Description: Thunder Clap and Execute have a 35% chance to strike the target with a thunderbolt causing 8 high threat Nature damage.

Name: Thundering Blow
Description: When Shockwave hits an enemy affected by your Thunder Clap it unleashes an additional Nature strike for 25% of the damage dealt. Reduces the cooldown of Shockwave for each enemy hit by this additional strike by 1 second, up to 10 seconds.

Name: Thunderlord
Description: While affected by Avatar your chance to trigger Thunderburst is increased by 25%.    Dealing Nature damage with spells grants Thunderlord.      Thunderlord Increases the damage of your next Concussion Blow by 10%, plus an additional 5% against monsters. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Tidecaller's Blessing
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Casting direct Nature heals now grants you Tidecaller's Blessing.    Tidecaller's Blessing Increases the healing of your next Wild Growth by 8%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Tidecaller's Boon
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Your Healing Wave heals for 50% more and applies 3 stacks of Tidecaller's Boon.    Tidecaller's Boon Receives 4% reduced healing from your Healing Wave.    Your periodic healing removes one stack. Stacks up to 15 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Tidecaller's Grace
Description: Your Tidecaller's Boon now increases your periodic healing on the target by 30% per stack.

Name: Tides of Battle
Description: Sinister Strike now grants you Ebb when used above 90% energy and Flow when used below 90% energy.    These effects cannot be active at the same time.    Ebb Increases your Physical damage by 4%, but drains 3% maximum energy per second. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 5 sec.    Flow Increases your Energy regeneration by 15%, but reduces your attack speed by 2%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 5 sec.

Name: Tidewaters
Description: While in combat, casting Renew, Rejuvenation or Riptide now grants you Tidewaters.     This effect can only occur from the same ally once every 8 seconds.      Tidewaters Increases the healing of your Healing Rain by 30% and reduces its cast time by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 8 sec.

Name: Timber Sentinels
Description: Increases the duration of your Force of Nature ability by 5 seconds.

Name: TIMBERRR
Description: Increases treants summoned by your Force of Nature by 3.    When used with Guardians of the Grove, reduces their healing done by 20%.

Name: Timed Charge
Description: Returning with Alter Time causes energy from the time rift to explode, dealing 456 Arcane damage and stunning nearby enemies for 3 sec.

Name: Titan's Fury
Description: Using Titanic Strike grants Titan's Fury.      Titan's Fury Increases your melee attack speed by 150% but burns all your rage, energy and runes for 4 seconds.    This can not occur more than once every 12 seconds

Name: Tools of War
Description: Each unique direct damage Physical ability now grants you Tools of War.      Tools of War Increases Physical damage dealt by 3%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 8 sec. Dealing magic damage resets all stacks. The duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Torrential Riptide
Description: Effective direct heals with Downpour grant you Torrential Riptide.   Torrential Riptide Increases the direct heal of your next Riptide by 25%, its critical heal chance by 8%, and causes it to reduce the cooldown of your Downpour by 1 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Toss and Throw
Description: Using Deadly Throw causes your next three casts of Shuriken Toss or Glaive Toss to generate an additional combo point, cost 40% fewer resources and deal 100% more damage against monsters. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Total Lunar Eclipse
Description: Lunar Eclipse now increases your Arcane damage by 20%.

Name: Total Solar Eclipse
Description: Solar Eclipse also increases your critical chance with Nature spells by 20%.

Name: Totem Master: Fire
Description: Your Fire Totems now gain 15% of your health, but their mana cost is increased by 200%.    Your Magma totem lasts 30% longer.

Name: Totemic Avatar
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Greater Elemental Totems by 50%.

Name: Touchy Topic
Description: Dealing damage with your Water Elemental's Freeze now grants you Fingers of Frost.    Fingers of Frost Your spells and abilities treat the target as if it were Frozen. Holds 2 charges. Lasts for 15 seconds.

Name: Toxic Strikes
Description: Dealing damage with Instant Poison grants you Toxic Strikes.    Critical strikes with Instant Poison grant you Hydra's Fang.      Toxic Strikes Slam, Overpower and Mortal Strike consume your Toxic Strikes stacks to deal 10% increased damage per stack. Stacks up to 10 times. Lasts 12 sec.    Hydra's Fang Slam, Overpower and Mortal Strike consume 3 stacks to deal 4 additional Nature damage. Stacks up to 12 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Transcendental Embrace
Description: Critical healing with Lesser Healing Wave, Healing Wave, Regrowth, and Healing Touch now grant you Transcendental Embrace.      Transcendental Embrace Your next Chain Heal has 15% increased critical strike chance, 15% reduced cast time, and jumps to an additional ally. Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 20 sec.

Name: Transference of Guilt
Description: Your Righteous Defense ability now transfers 10% more of your allies threat to you.

Name: Trauma Care
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Trauma Care.    Trauma Care Makes your next Greater Heal instant, heals an additional target, and increases its healing by 100%. Can hold up to 2 charges and lasts for 16 sec.

Name: Traumatic Wounds
Description: Dealing damage with Claw, Shred, Ravage, Mangle (Cat) and Bloodthirst extends the duration of Rip and Rake by 2 seconds. Rake periodic damage also generates 5 Energy.

Name: Treant Cultivation
Description: Casting Swiftmend reduces the cooldown of Force of Nature by 9 seconds.

Name: Tribal Rage
Description: Your melee criticals reduce the cooldown of Shamanistic Rage by 2 seconds.    Your direct damaging spell criticals extend the duration of Shamanistic Rage by 1 seconds.

Name: Trick Shots
Description: Multi-Shot now grants you Trick Shot when hitting 3 or more targets.      Trick Shot Your next Aimed Shot, Kill Shot or Arcane Shot ricochets to 5 nearby enemies, losing momentum with every target hit. Lasts for 6 sec.

Name: Trisolaris
Description: Fireball and Pyroblast tick one additional time and their damage over time effect can now stack up to 4 times.

Name: Troll Sweat
Description: Killing a player gives you a permanent stack of troll sweat. This tells heroes how sweaty you are. All sweat is lost on death. Accumulate enough sweat and reap the rewards.   If it Troll Sweats it Troll Sweats.

Name: Tundra Tracker
Description: Hunter shots now grant a stack of Tundra Tracker. Steady Shot grants 3 stacks.     Reaching 9 stacks consumes Tundra Tracker, granting Fingers of Frost if known. Lasts for 12 sec.    The duration of Tundra Tracker cannot be refreshed.

Name: Turning Tides
Description: For each enemy hit by your Typhoon the duration of your Riptide is increased by 4 seconds.

Name: Twilight Eruption
Description: Dealing damage with Mind Blast or Haunt reduces the remaining cooldown of Lava Burst by 1 sec. Dealing damage with Lava Burst extends your Unstable Affliction and Vampiric Touch on the target by 1 sec.

Name: Twilight Paragon
Description: Exorcism now consumes Paragon of Light to trigger Twilight Treason, increasing its damage by 15% per stack and transforms you into a Paragon of Darkness for 1 second per stack.      Twilight Treason Deals 80 Twilight damage to the target.    Paragon of Darkness Your Mind Flay, Mind Sear and Penance deal additional Twilight damage and you gain 10% spell critical strike chance.

Name: Twin Fangs
Description: Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite and Counterattack have a 50% chance to trigger Twin Fang, dealing 100% of the damage dealt as Physical damage.    Requires a weapon equipped in your off hand.

Name: Twist of Faith
Description: Using Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Command, Seal of Vengeance, Seal of Fervor, or Seal of Arcane Wrath while a different one of these seals is already active grants you the previously active seal for 10 sec.  These seals cost no mana but have a 10 second cooldown.

Name: Umbral Wounds
Description: While in Shadowform, your Deep Wounds deal Shadowstrike damage but no longer a bleed.

Name: Unchained
Description: Your Blink now slows nearby enemies by 50% for 2 sec.

Name: Undaunted
Description: Your Last Stand now sacrifices 5% of its maximum health granted to remove your Stagger debuff, clearing all stored damage.

Name: Unholy Commander
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Summon Gargoyle by 60 sec and removes its cost.    While your Gargoyle is active, Grave Coil commands it to fire Gargoyle's Wrath at your target.      Gargoyle's Wrath Deals 120 Plague damage and chains to nearby enemies.

Name: Unseen Assassin
Description: For 3 sec after leaving Stealth or activating Shadow Dance, your Glaive Toss, Deadly Throw and Shuriken Toss only triggers a 0.5 sec global cooldown and deal 60% increased damage against monsters.    Deadly Throw and Shuriken Toss deal 30% reduced damage against players whilst affected by Unseen Assassin

Name: Unstoppable Force
Description: Your Slam is now guaranteed to critically hit when used on an Incapacitated or Immobilized target.

Name: Upper Hand
Description: When one of your Hunter traps triggers, your next Rogue ability critically strikes.

Name: Ursine Frenzy
Description: Dealing damage with Thrash and Lacerate has a 10% chance to grant you Ursine Frenzy.    This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.      Ursine Frenzy Increases the damage of Mangle (Bear) by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 5 sec.    While Ursine Frenzy is active Mangle (Bear) has no cooldown and generates more stacks, but will not extend the duration.

Name: Ursoc's Blessing
Description: Bear Form's bonus Stamina and Armor persists for 3 seconds after leaving Bear Form.

Name: Ursoc's Rage
Description: Using Maul, Mangle or Lacerate reduces the cooldown of Enrage by 2 seconds. Enrage also reduces the rage cost of Ironfur by 50%.

Name: Vampire Lord
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Dealing damage with your Shadow Priest damage over time spells or healing with Shadow Mend generates a stack of Vampiric Essence.     Mind Flay generates 2 stacks per tick.    Each tick of Mind Sear can consume 3 Vampiric Essence to heal up to 5 allies for 199 health.    Vampiric Essence can stack up to 30 times.

Name: Vampiric Death
Description: Shadow Word: Death consumes your Vampiric Touch on the target, dealing Shadow damage equal to 100% of its total damage. This is increased to 220% if Shadow Word: Death critically strikes.    Shadow Word: Death's self-inflicted damage is reduced by 80%.

Name: Vampirism
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Your Vampiric Embrace healing now scales with Healing Power and heals the lowest-health ally in your party or raid. It no longer provides additional healing to you.    Targets do not need to be in your party or raid. Each heal cannot exceed 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Vengeful Plague
Description: While Seal of Vengeance is active, your Blood Plague now deals 50% more damage.

Name: Venomous Wound
Description: Critical strikes with Slam, Overpower or Mortal Strike against a bleeding target afflict them with Venomous Wound.    Venomous Wound Target takes 75% more damage from your Instant Poison. Holds 3 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Versatile Power
Description: Your Expose Weakness also grants 2% increased Spell Critical Chance.

Name: Victorious Charge
Description: Casting Charge now grants you Victorious, allowing you to cast Victory Rush once.    This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.    Victorious Allows the use of Victory Rush!

Name: Victorious Stand
Description: Dealing damage with Victory Rush reduces Last Stands cooldown by 10 sec.     Using Last Stand grants one use of Victory Rush, which will further reduce its cooldown by 35 sec.

Name: Violent Combo
Description: Finishing moves have a 20% chance to grant 2 combo points.

Name: Virulent Dominion
Description: The periodic damage from your Frost Fever, Blood Plague, and Unholy Blight can critically strike.  Pestilence also spreads your Unholy Blight from its primary target.  Scourge Strike applies Virulent Dominion, causing your next Frost Fever or Blood Plague tick to deal 100% increased damage.

Name: Viscera
Description: The periodic damage of Lacerate, Thrash, and auto attacks have a 15% chance of resetting the cooldown of Pulverize, and makes your next Pulverize hit up to 3 targets.

Name: Void Teleportation
Description: Using Void Shift also swaps the position of the caster and the target.

Name: Voidblade
Description: Shadow spells increase the damage of your combo point generating Rogue abilities by 3% and Dark Intent by additional 3%. Stacks up to 3.   Rogue combo point generating abilities have a chance to increase the damage taken from your Shadow Word: Pain by 80% for 8 sec.  The duration of Voidblade is not refreshable at max stacks.

Name: Volcanic Shamanism
Description: Lava Burst reduces the active cooldown of Flame Ascendance by 8 seconds.

Name: Voltaic Companion
Description: Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks now deal Nature damage.    Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks can only be transformed to one damage type at once.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Wacky Wizardry
Description: Your offensive Mage spell casts have a 25% chance to cast an additional random Mage spell for free.

Name: Waking Nightmare
Description: Your Haunt applies Waking Nightmare to the target. When that target is healed, the healer is afflicted with Phantom Nightmare.    Phantom Nightmare You deal 10% increased Shadow damage to the target. Fear effects last 50% longer against them.

Name: Wanding
Description: Wand attacks grant you stacks that increase the cast speed of your next spell by 5%, stacks up to 5 times and lasts 6 sec.

Name: Waning Moon
Description: Dealing periodic damage with Moonfire grants you Waning Moon. This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.    Waning Moon Reduces the cast time of your next Arcane Blast or Starfire by 10%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: War Mage
Description: Casting Blink causes an Arcane Explosion at your arrival point, reducing Blink's cooldown by 1.5 sec for each target hit up to a max of 9 seconds.    If you know Arcane Explosion or Arcanist's Explosion you will cast your highest rank known.

Name: Ward of Light
Description: Using Divine Storm now reduces your periodic magic damage taken by 15% for 5 sec. Taking spell damage has a chance to reset the cooldown of Divine Storm.

Name: Weapon Command
Description: Wielding a single Two-Handed weapon now increases your Physical damage by 10% and melee critical strike chance by 4%.    This effect does not work while in Cat, Bear Form, or with Titan's Grip talent.

Name: Whirl of Rage
Description: Dealing damage with Whirlwind now grants you Bloodrage.    Bloodrage Generates 20 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.    It also grants you Enrage if known.    Enrage Physical damage increased by 10%. Haste increased by 10%.

Name: Whirling Bladestorm
Description: Bladestorm now increases your movement speed by 35% while active. Players hit by Bladestorm are knocked into the air.    Each player can only be knocked up once.

Name: Whispers of the Old Gods
Description: Dealing damage with Shadow Word: Pain now has a 35% chance to summon a Tentacle of the Old Gods to wreak havoc on your enemies.     Each Tentacle summoned increases the damage of your Grasp of Darkness by 15% and its critical strike damage bonus by 15%.    Can only trigger from the same target once every 7 sec seconds.

Name: Widowmaker
Description: Direct Hunter damage against a target affected by your Black Arrow or Black Widow Strike has a 25% chance to trigger Widowhail.    Widowhail deals 40% of the triggering damage as Shadow damage to enemies in a 5-yard area and increases the damage they take from your Black Arrow and Black Widow Strike by 30% for 12 sec.

Name: Wild Aggression
Description: Dealing damage with Mongoose Bite or Savage Blade now restores 40 energy and grants you Wild Aggression.    Wild Aggression Increases the damage of your Rogue abilities by 15%. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Wild Felfire
Description: Dealing damage with Chaos Bolt now calls down a fiery rain, dealing 42 Chaos damage to nearby enemies every second for 8 sec.

Name: Wild Wrath
Description: Dealing damage with Steady Shot or Chimera Shot grants you Wild Wrath.    Wild Wrath Your next Wrath has a 34% reduced cast time and 15% increased damage. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 12 sec.    If cast at 3 stacks, Wrath refreshes Insect Swarm and resets the cooldown of Chimera Shot.

Name: Wildclaw
Description: Maul has a 12% chance to grant you Wildclaw.      Wildclaw Your next Bloodthirst deals 125% increased damage, hits 3 additional targets, and generates 100% increased threat.

Name: Will of Elune
Description: Your Healing Touch and Regrowth direct heals have a chance to grant party members 2% Spirit for 10 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Will of Pa'ku
Description: Your Zandalari Glaive increases the target's damage taken from your Windfury Weapon by 5%. Lasts 10 sec. Stacks up to 10.  Dealing damage with Loa's Assault reduces the cooldown of Ravager by 1.5 seconds. While affected by Windfury Weapon casting Ravager triggers Pa'ku's Wrath.      Pa'ku's Wrath Each of your next 6 Loa's Assault hits deals an additional 110% weapon damage.    This uses Windfury Weapon damage modifiers.

Name: Wind Rager
Description: Dealing damage with Stormstrike reduces the cooldown of Whirlwind by 2 sec, and dealing damage with Whirlwind reduces the cooldown of Stormstrike by 2 sec.    Dealing damage with either ability grants Volcanic Tempest, increasing the damage of your next Lava Lash against monsters by 15%. Stacks up to 2 times.

Name: Wind Slam
Description: Dealing damage with Windfury grants you Wind Slam    Wind Slam Your next Shield Slam or Shield of Righteousness slams nearby targets with wind, dealing 19 Physical damage and slowing their attack speed by 20% for 30 sec.

Name: Wingman
Description: Challenging Shout now decreases the damage taken by your allies by 10% for 8 sec.

Name: Winter's Lock
Description: Chains of Ice brands the target with Winter's Lock.      Winter's Lock Increases Frost damage you deal to this target by 5%. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Wisdom of Elune
Description: Your Moonfire damage over time effect has a chance to grant party members 2% Intellect for 10 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Words of Healing
Description: While Borrowed Time is active, your critical effect chance with direct heals is increased by 30%.

Name: Words of Time
Description: Your Borrowed Time is no longer consumed when casting.

Name: Wrath of the Plague
Description: Your Wrath now afflicts enemies affected by your Haunt or Blood Plague with Wrath of the Plague.      Wrath of the Plague Disease the enemy, dealing 2 Shadow damage every 0.5 sec for 2.50 sec.    This damage can critically strike.

Name: Wrath of the Sun
Description: While Solar Eclipse is active your Wrath deals 100% increased damage but has 0.75 increased cast time.

Name: Wrathful Strikes
Description: Feral finishing moves now have a 20% chance per combo point spent to grant you Wrathful Strikes.    Wrathful Strikes Your next Wrath can be cast in Cat Form, is instant, and deals 40% increased damage.

Name: Zany Zealot
Description: Your offensive Priest spell casts have a 25% chance to cast an additional random Priest spell for free.

Name: Zephyr
Description: Dealing damage with Windfury grants you Wrath of Al'Akir.    Wrath of Al'Akir Increases your chance to trigger Windfury by 2% and your melee attack speed by 1%.    While at max stacks, your next Windfury hits 2 additional times and consumes all stacks. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Animal Handler
Description: Increases your tamed beast's attack power by 12% and increases the duration of your Master's Call effect by 6 sec.

Name: Aspect Mastery
Description: Aspect of the Viper - Reduces the damage and healing penalty by 10%.  Aspect of the Monkey - Reduces the damage done to you while active by 5%.  Aspect of the Hawk - Increases the attack power bonus by 30%.    Aspect of the Dragonhawk - Combines the bonuses from Aspect of the Monkey and Hawk.

Name: Bestial Discipline
Description: Increases the Focus regeneration of your tamed pets by 100%.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Catlike Reflexes
Description: Increases your chance to dodge by 3% and your tamed beast's chance to dodge by an additional 12%.     Reduces the cooldown of your Kill Command ability by 30 sec.

Name: Cobra Strikes
Description: You have a 60% chance when you critically hit with a Ranged or Melee ability to cause your tamed beast's next 2 special attacks to critically hit.

Name: Endurance Training
Description: Increases your total health by 5%.    Increases the health of your tamed beast, enslaved demon, dominated undead, tamed dragonkin, and tethered elemental by 15%.

Name: Ferocious Inspiration
Description: Increases the damage of all party and raid members by 3%.   Does not stack with other similar effects.    Increases the damage dealt by Arcane Shot and Steady Shot by 9%.

Name: Ferocity
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your tamed pet by 15%.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Focused Fire
Description: All damage caused by you and your pet is increased by 2% while your pet is active and the critical strike chance of your tamed beast's special abilities is increased by 20% while Kill Command is active.

Name: Frenzy
Description: Gives your pet a 100% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Improved Aspect of the Hawk
Description: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, all Ranged or Melee abilities have a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 15% for 12 sec.

Name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
Description: Increases the dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey and Aspect of the Dragonhawk by 6%.

Name: Improved Mend Pet
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Mend Pet spell by 20%.    Mend Pet has a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic or Poison effect from the pet each tick.

Name: Improved Revive Pet
Description: All pet revival spells have their cast times reduced by 6 seconds, mana costs reduced by 40%, and the health your pet returns with is increased by an additional 30%.    Revive Pet includes; Revive Elemental, Revive Dragonkin, Revive Undead, Revive Demon.

Name: Invigoration
Description: When your tamed beast scores a critical hit with a special ability, you have a 100% chance to instantly regenerate 1% mana.

Name: Kindred Spirits
Description: Increases your Tamed Pet's damage and healing by 35% and your Tamed Pet's movement speed by 10%.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Longevity
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Bestial Wrath, Intimidation and Tamed Beast Pet Special Abilities by 30%.

Name: Pathfinding
Description: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 8%.    Increases your speed while mounted by 10%. The mounted movement speed increase does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Primal Reflexes
Description: Increases the dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey and Aspect of the Dragonhawk by 8%.

Name: Serpent's Swiftness
Description: Increases ranged combat attack speed by 20% and your tamed beast's melee attack speed by 20%.

Name: Spirit Bond
Description: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 2% of total health every 10 sec.    Increases healing done to you and your pet by 10%. This effect does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: The Beast Within
Description: While your tamed beast or tamed dragonkin is under the effects of Bestial Wrath, you also go into a rage causing 15% additional damage and reducing mana costs of all spells and ranged abilities by 50% for 10 sec. While enraged, you do not feel pity or remorse or fear and you cannot be stopped unless killed.  Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Thick Hide
Description: Increases the armor rating of your tamed beast by 20% and your armor contribution from items by 10%.

Name: Unleashed Fury
Description: Increases the damage done by your Tamed Pet by 25%, and Tamed Beast special attacks by an additional 25%.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Barrage
Description: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot and Volley spells by 12%.

Name: Careful Aim
Description: Requires  Primary Stat: Agility    Increases your hit chance by 3%.   Increases your ranged attack power by an amount equal to 60% of your total Intellect

Name: Combat Experience
Description: Increases your total Agility by 4%.    Increases your melee and ranged critical strike chance by 4%.

Name: Concussive Barrage
Description: Your successful Chimera Shot and Multi-Shot attacks have a 100% chance to Daze the target for 4 seconds.

Name: Efficiency
Description: Increases your Ranged attack speed by 10%.    Reduces the mana cost of your Shots and Stings by 30%.

Name: Focused Aim
Description: Increases your hit chance by 2%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Steady Shot by 70%.

Name: Go for the Throat
Description: Your ranged and melee critical strikes cause your tamed beast to generate 50 Focus.    Dominate undead, enslaved demon or tamed dragonkin generate 50 Energy.     This effect cannot occur more than once every 2 seconds.

Name: Improved Arcane Shot
Description: Increases the damage done by your Arcane Shot by 15%.

Name: Improved Barrage
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Quick Shot, Multi-Shot and Aimed Shot abilities by 12%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while channeling Volley by 100%.

Name: Improved Concussive Shot
Description: Increases the duration of your Concussive Shot's daze effect by 2 sec.

Name: Improved Hunter's Mark
Description: Increases the bonus attack power granted by your Hunter's Mark ability by 30%.    Reduces the mana cost of your Hunter's Mark ability by 100%.

Name: Improved Steady Shot
Description: Your Steady Shot has a 50% chance to empower your next Aimed Shot, Arcane Shot, Chimera Shot, or Multi-Shots, increasing its damage by 20% and reducing its mana cost by 25%.

Name: Improved Stings
Description: Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 20%, and the effectiveness of Viper Sting by 30%.  Capstone Bonus: If your Serpent Sting is dispelled, the target is afflicted by Serpent's Kiss for 5 sec. Using Chimera Shot on a target afflicted by your Serpent's Kiss deals bonus Nature damage and applies Serpent Sting.

Name: Lethal Shots
Description: Increases your critical strike chance with ranged weapons by 5%.

Name: Marked for Death
Description: Increases the damage done by 6% on targets affected by Hunter's Mark.    Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Hunter Abilities by 12%.

Name: Master Marksman
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 6%.     Reduces the mana cost of your Steady Shot, Aimed Shot, Chimera Shot and Kill Shot by 25%.

Name: Mortal Shots
Description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your ranged abilities by 30%.

Name: Perforating Shots
Description: Requires  Primary Stat: Strength Piercing Shots also causes your attacks to pierce 20% of the target's armor.

Name: Piercing Shots
Description: Your critical Aimed Shot, Steady Shot, Arcane Shot, Chimera Shot, Multi-Shot and Kill Shot cause the target to take 40% of the damage dealt over 8 seconds.

Name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
Description: Increases the damage dealt by your Auto Shot and Hunter Shots by 6%.

Name: Rapid Killing
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Rapid Fire ability by 180 seconds.     Killing an opponent that yields experience or honor makes your next two Aimed Shot, Arcane Shot or Chimera Shots cause 20% additional damage.

Name: Rapid Recuperation
Description: Regenerate 6% of your base mana every 3 sec while under the effect of Rapid Fire.    Regenerate 2% of your base mana every 2 sec when you gain Rapid Killing.

Name: Wild Quiver
Description: You have a 30% chance to shoot an additional shot when dealing damage with your Auto Shot or Steady Shot, dealing 60% weapon Nature damage.

Name: Entrapment
Description: When your Frost Trap or Snake Trap is triggered you entrap all afflicted targets, preventing them from moving for 4 sec.

Name: Expose Weakness
Description: Critical strikes have a 100% chance to grant you Expose Weakness. Expose Weakness increases your attack power by 25% of your Agility for 7 sec.

Name: Hawk Eye
Description: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.

Name: Hunter vs. Wild
Description: Increases your attack power and ranged attack power equal to 30% of your total Stamina.

Name: Hunting for Sport
Description: Increases damage done by 12% to targets under 35% health.    Increases Expertise by 6.

Name: Hunting Party
Description: Increases your Agility by 3%.  Your Arcane Shot, Explosive Shot and Steady Shot critical strikes have a 100% chance to grant Replenishment.    Replenishment Replenishes 1% of maximum mana per 5 sec on up to 10 party members for 15 sec.

Name: Improved Glaive Toss
Description: Increases the damage of your Glaive Toss by 15%.  Capstone Bonus: Your Glaive Toss jumps to 2 additional nearby targets, and if you are further than 15 yards away targets hit are slowed by 30% for 3 sec.

Name: Killer Instinct
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.     You have a 100% chance to allow the use of your Counterattack ability after using Mongoose Bite, Explosive Shot or Glaive Toss for 8 sec.     This effect can only occur once every 6 seconds.

Name: Lightning Reflexes

Description: Requires  Primary Stat: Might or Finesse Increases your bonus spell healing by an amount equal to 20% of your melee attack power and your melee critical chance by 3%.  Capstone Bonus: Healing yourself with a cast time heal restores 8% of your base mana.

Name: Pursuit of Justice
Description: Reduces the duration of all Disarm effects by 50% and increases your movement speed by 15%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

Name: Righteous Vengeance
Description: Direct critical strikes with spells and abilities make your target take 30% additional damage over 8 seconds as Holy damage.

Name: Sanctified Retribution
Description: Increases the damage of all party and raid members by 3%.   Does not stack with other similar effects.    Increases the damage caused by Retribution Aura by 50%.

Name: Sanctified Wrath
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Hammer of Wrath by 50%.    Reduces the cooldown of Avenging Wrath by 60 secs and while affected by Avenging Wrath 50% of all damage caused bypasses damage reduction effects.

Name: Sanctity of Battle
Description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 3%.    Increases the damage caused by Exorcism, Crusader Strike and Execution Sentence by 15%.

Name: Sheath of Light
Description: Your critical healing spells heal for an additional 30% of the healed amount over 12 seconds.    Sheath of Light is doubled for Single Target heals.

Name: Swift Retribution
Description: Increases the haste of all party and raid members by 3%.

Name: The Art of War
Description: Increases the damage of your Judgement, Crusader Strike, Execution Sentence and Divine Storm abilities by 9%.    Dealing direct damage with Holy and Physical abilities or spells has a 50% chance to reduce the cast time of your next Flash of Light or Exorcism by 100%.      This effect has a 6 second cooldown.

Name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
Description: Increases the physical damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 6%.

Name: Vengeance
Description: Gives you a 3% bonus to Physical and Holy damage you deal after dealing a direct critical strike.     Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 30 seconds.

Name: Vindication
Description: Gives your Holy spells and Paladin melee abilities a 65% chance to reduce the targets attack power by 2 (scaling with level).    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Absolution
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Dispel Magic, Cure Disease, Abolish Disease and Mass Dispel spells by 15%.

Name: Aspiration
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Inner Focus, Power Infusion, Pain Suppression, Leap of Faith and Penance spells by 20%.     Increases the duration of Pain Suppression by 2 sec.

Name: Borrowed Time
Description: Grants 20% spell haste for 6 sec after casting Power Word: Shield. This effect is consumed by your next non-instant spell.     Increases the healing power scaling of your Power Word: Shield by 40%.

Name: Divine Aegis
Description: Your effective critical healing creates a protective barrier absorbing damage up to 15% of the healed amount for 6 sec.    Divine Aegis is doubled for single target heals.    The absorb from Divine Aegis is limited to 10% of the target's maximum health.

Name: Enlightenment
Description: Increases your total Spirit, Intellect and haste by 3%.

Name: Focused Power
Description: Increases all damage and healing done by 4%.     The cast time of Mass dispel is reduced 1 sec.

Name: Focused Will
Description: Increases your spell critical effect chance by 3%,  Capstone Bonus: Gain the Focused Will effect whenever you take a critical hit, increasing healing taken by 5% and decreasing damage taken by 4%. This effect stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 seconds.

Name: Grace
Description: Your Direct Heals and Power Word: Shield grant Grace, increasing the target's healing received from you by 3% for 12 sec. Stacks up to 3 times and can only affect one target.

Name: Improved Flash Heal
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Flash Heal by 10%, and increases the critical effect chance of your Flash Heal by 15% on friendly targets at or below 50% health.  Capstone Bonus: Flash Heal casts reduce the cooldown of Inner Focus by 2 seconds.

Name: Improved Inner Fire
Description: Increases the effect of your Inner Fire spell by 45%, and increases the total number of charges by 12.

Name: Improved Mana Burn
Description: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 1 sec.

Name: Improved Power Word: Fortitude
Description: Increases your total Stamina by 4%.    Increases the effect of your Power Word: Fortitude and Prayer of Fortitude spells by 30%.

Name: Improved Power Word: Shield
Description: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 15%.

Name: Martyrdom
Description: You gain Focused Casting after being hit by a melee or ranged critical strike.     Focused Casting reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Priest spells by 100% and decreases the duration of Interrupt effects by 20%. Lasts 6 sec.

Name: Meditation
Description: Allows 25% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.  Capstone Bonus: Your spell critical strike rating is increased by 10% of your Spirit.

Name: Mental Agility
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your instant cast spells by 10%.

Name: Mental Strength
Description: Increases your total Intellect by 10%.    Reduces all magic damage taken by 3%.

Name: Rapture
Description: When your Power Word: Shield is completely absorbed or dispelled you are instantly energized with 2.5% of your total mana.    You have a 100% chance to energize your shielded target with 2% total mana, 8 rage and 16 energy. This effect can only occur once every 12 sec.

Name: Reflective Shield
Description: Causes 44% of the damage you absorb with Power Word: Shield to reflect back at the attacker.  This damage causes no threat.

Name: Renewed Hope
Description: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 6% on targets afflicted by the Weakened Soul effect.    You have a 100% chance to reduce all damage taken by 3% for 1 min to all friendly party and raid targets when you cast Power Word: Shield. This effect has a 15 sec cooldown.

Name: Silent Resolve
Description: Reduces the threat generated by your Holy and Discipline spells by 20% and reduces the chance your helpful spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by 30%.

Name: Soul Warding
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Power Word: Shield ability by 4 sec, and reduces the mana cost of your Power Word: Shield by 15%.

Name: Twin Disciplines
Description: Increases the damage and healing done by your Holy spells and abilities by 5%, and their critical strike chance by 5%.

Name: Unbreakable Will
Description: Reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects done to you by an additional 30%.  This does not stack with other Stun or Fear reduction effects.

Name: Answered Prayers
Description: Increases all damage done by 10% and all healing done by 10%.    Increases Holy damage by an additional 5%.    The all-damage increase does not stack with Enhanced Weapon Mastery, Unending Fury, Blessed Weapons, Blood Gorged or Blood Presence. Only the highest increase applies.    The healing increase does not stack with Spiritual Healing, Purification or Gift of Nature. Only the highest increase applies.

Name: Blessed Recovery
Description: After being struck by a critical strike, you heal for 15% of the damage taken over 6 sec, additional critical strikes taken during the effect increase the healing received.  Capstone Bonus: When Blessed Recovery is active, your Desperate Prayer will come off cooldown three times as fast.

Name: Blessed Resilience
Description: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 3%, and critical hits made against you have a 60% chance to prevent you from being critically hit again for 6 sec.    This can not occur more than once every 18 sec.

Name: Body and Soul
Description: When you cast Power Word: Shield or Leap of Faith, you increase the target's movement speed by 60% for 4 sec,    You have a 100% chance when you cast Abolish Disease on yourself to also cleanse 1 poison effect in addition to diseases.

Name: Divine Fury
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Holy Fire by 6%.     You deal 6% increased damage against targets afflicted by your Holy Fire.

Name: Divine Providence
Description: Increases the amount healed Holy Spells by 10%.     Reduces the cooldown of your Halo and Prayer of Mending by 30%.

Name: Empowered Healing
Description: Your Greater Heal, Flash Heal, Binding Heal, and Divine Star spells gain an additional 25% of your bonus healing effects.

Name: Empowered Renew
Description: Your Renew spell gains another 15% of your bonus healing effects.  Your Renew instantly heals the target for 15% of the total periodic effect.

Name: Healing Focus
Description: Increases your haste by 2%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by 70%.

Name: Healing Prayers
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Prayer of Healing, Prayer of Mending and Halo spell by 20% .    Increases the critical strike chance of your Prayer of Healing and Halo spell by 10%.

Name: Holy Concentration
Description: Your Spirit is increased by 30% for 12 sec after you critically heal with Flash Heal, Greater Heal, or Binding Heal, or critically hit with Holy Fire or Smite.     Greater Heal, Flash Heal, Binding Heal, and Circle of Healing have a 100% chance to extend the duration of your Renew on all nearby party and raid members by 3 sec, up to an additional 6 sec.     This does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Holy Focus
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.     This does not stack with other similar effects.   Capstone Bonus: Your Holy damaging spell critical strikes have a 50% chance to increase magic damage done by 5% for 6 seconds.     This effect can only occur once every 8 seconds.

Name: Holy Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells with a channeling or cast time by 6 yards.     This does not stack with other similar effects.    Increases the radius of your Prayer of Healing, Holy Nova, Divine Hymn, and Circle of Healing spells by 20%.   Capstone Bonus: Directly healing or directly damaging a target further than 20 yards away from you has a 20% chance to restore 2% of your missing mana over 4 sec. This effect can only occur once every 15 sec.

Name: Holy Specialization
Description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with all Holy spells and abilities by 5%.

Name: Improved Divine Star
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.    Increases the amount healed by your Divine Star spell by 30%.

Name: Improved Healing
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Greater Heal, Divine Hymn and Penance spells by 15%.

Name: Improved Renew
Description: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 15%.

Name: Inspiration
Description: Reduces your target's Physical damage taken by 10% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Radiant Fury
Description: Your Smite, Holy Fire and the damage of Holy Nova gains an additional 30% of your bonus spell damage effects.    Duration of Holy Fire is increased by 2.5 sec.

Name: Searing Light
Description: Increases the damage of your Smite, Holy Fire, Penance, Holy Nova, Holy Shock and Exorcism spells by 15%.    Reduces the mana cost of your Holy Nova by 25%.

Name: Serendipity
Description: When you heal with Binding Heal or Flash Heal, cast Renew, or deal damage with Smite, the cast time and mana cost of your next Greater Heal or Prayer of Healing spell is reduced by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Spell Warding
Description: Reduces all magic damage taken by 10%.

Name: Spirit of Redemption
Description: Increases total Spirit by 5% and upon death, you becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec.      The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects.  While in this form you can cast any healing spell free of cost.  When the effect ends, you die.

Name: Spiritual Guidance
Description: Increases spell power by 25% of your total Spirit.

Name: Spiritual Healing
Description: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.    The healing increase does not stack with Purification, Gift of Nature or Answered Prayers. Only the highest increase applies.

Name: Surge of Light
Description: Your direct damage and healing spell and ability criticals have a 50% chance to cause your next Smite or Flash Heal spell to be instant cast and cost no mana but are incapable of a critical hit. This effect lasts 10 sec.

Name: Test of Faith
Description: Increases healing and damage done to targets below 50% health by 12%.

Name: Darkness
Description: Increases all damage done by 3%.    Increases your Shadow damage done by 3%.

Name: Improved Devouring Plague
Description: Increases the periodic damage done by your Devouring Plague by 15%.    Devouring Plague now instantly deals 30% of its total periodic effect when cast.  You deal 3% increased damage against targets afflicted by your Devouring Plague.

Name: Improved Mind Blast
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 2.5 sec.    Mind Blast also has a 100% chance to reduce all healing done to the target by 20% for 10 sec.

Name: Improved Psychic Scream
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 4 sec.

Name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
Description: Increases the damage of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 6%.

Name: Improved Shadowform
Description: Your Fade has a 100% chance to clear all movement impairing effects when used in Shadowform.  While in Shadowform, you also take 15% less damage and lose 70% less casting or channeling time when hit while casting Shadow spells

Name: Improved Spirit Tap
Description: Your Spirit Tap now also triggers from your critical strikes with direct damage Shadow spells and Mind Flay and now also increases critical strike rating by 10% of your Spirit.

Name: Improved Vampiric Embrace
Description: Increases the healing received from Vampiric Embrace by 67%.

Name: Mind Melt
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Mind Blast, Shadow Word: Death, Mind Flay and Mind Sear spells by 4%.    Increases the periodic critical strike chance of your damaging periodic spells by 6%.

Name: Misery
Description: Your Mind Blast, Mind Flay and Mind Sear gain an additional 15% of your bonus spell damage effects.    Your Shadow Word: Pain, Mind Flay and Vampiric Touch spells increase the chance for harmful spells to hit by 3% lasting 24 sec.

Name: Pain and Suffering
Description: Shadow channeled spells and Mind Blast casts have a 100% chance to refresh the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain on the target.    Reduces the damage you take from your own Shadow Word: Death by 30%.

Name: Shadow Affinity
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Shadow spells by 6%.    You receive 15% of your base mana when your Shadow Word: Pain or Vampiric Touch spells are dispelled.  Capstone Bonus: All threat generated is reduced by 30%. This capstone effect does not stack with similar capstone effects.

Name: Shadow Focus
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your spells by 6%.    Reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 70%.

Name: Shadow Power
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.     This does not stack with other similar effects.   Capstone Bonus: Your Shadow and Holy periodic damage effects have a 30% chance to make the target vulnerable to your power, increasing their Magic damage taken from you by 4% for 4 seconds.

Name: Shadow Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells with a channeling or cast time by 6 yards.     This does not stack with other similar effects.  Dealing direct magic damage to a target further than 20 yards away from you has a 33% chance to corrupt their soul, dealing Shadow damage over 3 seconds. This effect can only occur once every 15 sec.

Name: Shadow Weaving
Description: Your damaging Priest Shadow spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 15 sec.  Stacks up to 5 times.

Name: Spirit Tap
Description: You have a 100% chance to gain Spirit Tap after killing a target that yields experience or honor.     Your Spirit is increased by 30% and your mana will regenerate at 75% rate while casting.   Lasts 15 sec.  This does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Twisted Faith
Description: Increases your spell power by 20% of your total Spirit.    Increases the damage done by your Mind Flay and Mind Blast is increased by 10% if your target is afflicted by your Shadow Word: Pain.

Name: Veiled Shadows
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shadowfiend ability by 120 sec and of your Fade ability by 6 sec.

Name: Void-touched Mind

Name: Blood Spatter

Name: Cut to the Chase

Name: Deadened Nerves
Description: Reduces all damage taken by 6%.

Name: Deadly Brew
Description: When you apply Instant, Deadly or Mind-Numbing poison to a target, you have a 100% chance to apply Crippling poison.     This effect can only occur once every 1 seconds.

Name: Find Weakness
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 6%.    Capstone Bonus: The periodic damage of your Garrote is able to critically hit.

Name: Fleet Footed
Description: Reduces the duration of all movement impairing effects by 30% and increases your movement speed by 15%.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

Name: Focused Attacks

Name: Improved Eviscerate
Description: Increases the damage of your Eviscerate ability by 20%.

Name: Improved Expose Armor
Description: Reduces the energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, increases its duration by 50%, and your attacks ignore an additional 12% of your target's armor.

Name: Improved Kidney Shot

Name: Improved Poisons
Description: Increases the chance to apply Deadly Poison to your target by 20% and the frequency of applying Instant Poison to your target by 50%.

Name: Insatiable Blood
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Hunger for Blood by 30 seconds.     Casting Hunger for Blood reduces its remaining cooldown by an additional 1 second for each of your Bleed effects on the target.

Name: Lethality
Description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of all non-periodic combo point-generating Rogue abilities and Rogue poisons by 30%.

Name: Malice
Description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 5%.  Capstone Bonus: You gain 5 Energy when your Garrote, Rupture or Crimson Tempest deal damage.

Name: Master Poisoner
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of all spells and attacks against any target you have poisoned by 3%.    Reduces the duration of all Poison effects applied to you by 50%.    Envenom has a 100% chance not to consume Deadly Poison.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Murder
Description: Increases all damage done by 2%     Increases the duration of the Silence effect from Garrote by 0.5 sec.

Name: Overkill
Description: While stealthed, and for 20 sec seconds after breaking stealth, you regenerate 30% additional energy.

Name: Puncturing Wounds
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab ability by 30%.    Increases the critical strike chance of your Mutilate ability by 15%.

Name: Quick Recovery
Description: Increases healing done to you by 20%.   This effect does not stack with other similar effects.   Your Rogue finishing moves refund 80% of their Energy cost when they fail to hit.

Name: Remorseless Attacks
Description: After killing an opponent that yields experience or honor, gives you a 40% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Hemorrhage, Backstab, Mutilate, Ambush, or Ghostly Strike.  Lasts 20 sec.  Capstone Bonus: Triggering Remorseless Attacks also refreshes your Slice and Dice duration to its 5 combo point maximum.

Name: Ruthlessness
Description: Increases the damage of your Rogue finishing moves by 6%.     Your Rogue melee finishing moves have a 60% chance to add a combo point.    This effect cannot occur more than once every 2 seconds.

Name: Seal Fate

Increases the damage done by Eviscerate, Rupture, Deadly Throw and Crimson Tempest by 10%.  Capstone Bonus: Consuming Cold Blood with a finishing move has a 20% chance per combo point to increase your movement speed by 70% for 4 sec.

Name: Turn the Tables
Description: Whenever anyone in your party or raid blocks, dodges, or parries an attack your chance to critically hit with combo point generators and haste is increased by 6% for 8 sec.

Name: Vigor
Description: Increases your maximum Energy by 20.

Name: Vile Poisons
Description: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons and Envenom ability by 20%.    Gives your damage over time poisons an additional 30% chance to resist dispel effects.

Name: Accuracy
Description: Increases your chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 5%.

Name: Aggression
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Sinister Strike, Shuriken Toss, Deadly Throw and Eviscerate by 15%.     Increases the duration of effects gained from Roll the Bones by 15 sec.    Capstone Bonus: Your finishing moves reduces the cooldown of Roll the Bones by 2 sec per combo point used.

Name: Blade Twisting
Description: Increases the damage dealt by Sinister Strike, Backstab and Shiv by 10%, and your Shiv and Grappling Hook Follow-Up has a 100% chance to Daze the target for 4 sec.

Name: Close Quarters Combat

Name: Combat Potency

Name: Deflection
