Name: Dual Wield Specialization
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%.    Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 33%.  Does not stack with Dual Wield Mastery

Name: Endurance
Description: Increases your total Stamina by 4%.    Reduces the cooldown of your Evasion and Sprint by 60 sec.

Name: Hack and Slash
Description: Gives you a 6% chance to get an extra attack with both weapons dealing 100% weapon damage after hitting your target with your One-Handed Sword or One-handed Axe.

Name: Improved Gouge
Description: Increases the effect duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec.

Name: Improved Kick
Description: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to silence the target for 2 sec.  Your successful interrupts with Kick grant you 40 energy.

Name: Improved Sinister Strike
Description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 5.

Name: Improved Slice and Dice
Description: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 50% and increases the attack speed it grants by 6%.

Name: Improved Sprint
Description: Gives a 100% chance to remove all Movement Impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

Name: Mace Specialization
Description: Increases your melee attack speed by 10% and armor penetration by 15% while a mace is equipped.

Name: Nerves of Steel
Description: Reduces damage taken while affected by Stun and Fear effects by 20%.

Name: Prey on the Weak
Description: Melee attacks against the target that has less health than you (as a percentage of total health) increase your critical strike damage bonus by 20%.

Name: Quick Reflexes
Description: Increases your haste by 9% and your Dodge chance by 6%.  Capstone Bonus: All threat generated is reduced by 30%. This capstone effect does not stack with similar capstone effects.

Name: Savage Combat
Description: Increases your total attack power by 4%.    All Physical damage on enemies you have poisoned is increased by 4%.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Surprise Attacks

Name: Throwing Specialization

Name: Vitality
Description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 40%.

Name: Weapon Expertise
Description: Increases your Expertise by 10.

Name: Camouflage
Description: Increases your speed while in Stealth or Prowl by 15%.    Reduces the cooldown of your Stealth and Prowl ability by 6 sec.

Name: Cheat Death
Description: You have a 100% chance to fully absorb an attack which would otherwise kill you, up to a maximum of 15% of your total health. In addition, all damage taken will be reduced by 50% for 3 sec.     This effect shares a 2 minute cooldown with Ardent Defender and Spirit of Redemption.  Capstone Bonus: With the final rank of this talent, cheating death also resets your Vanish.

Name: Deadliness
Description: Increases your attack power by 10%.

Name: Dirty Deeds
Description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20.     Your Rogue abilities cause 20% more damage against targets below 35% health.

Name: Dirty Tricks
Description: Increases the range of your Blind and Sap abilities by 5 yards.    Reduces the energy cost of your Blind and Sap abilities by 50%.

Name: Elusiveness
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Vanish and Smoke Bomb by 60 sec.     Reduces the cooldown of Cloak of Shadows by 30 sec.

Name: Enveloping Shadows

Name: Initiative
Description: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

Name: Master of Deception
Description: Greatly reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while using Stealth or Prowl.  More effective than Master of Deception (Rank 2).

Name: Master of Subtlety
Description: Physical attacks made while stealthed and for 6 seconds after breaking stealth cause an additional 12% damage.    Master of Subtlety doesn't stack with other similar effects.

Name: Opportunity
Description: Increases the damage dealt with your Backstab, Mutilate, Garrote, Ambush and Gloomblade abilities by 20%.

Name: Out of Nowhere
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 50%.

Name: Relentless Strikes
Description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to restore 25 energy.

Name: Serrated Blades
Description: Your attacks to ignore up to 18% of your target's Armor.    Increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

Name: Slaughter from the Shadows
Description: Reduces the energy cost of your Backstab and Ambush abilities by 10 and the energy cost of your Hemorrhage by 6.    Damaging spells and abilities have a 100% chance to reduce the cooldown of your Shadow Dance by 1 seconds.

Name: Sleight of Hand
Description: Reduces the chance you are critically hit by melee and ranged attacks by 2%.    Increases the threat reduction of your Feint ability by 20%.

Name: Waylay
Description: Your Ambush and Backstab hits have a 100% chance to unbalance a target, increasing the time between their melee and ranged attacks by 20%, and reducing movement speed by 50% for 8 sec.

Name: Astral Shift
Description: When stunned, feared or silenced you shift into the Astral Plane reducing all damage taken by 30% for the duration of the stun, fear or silence effect.

Name: Booming Echoes
Description: Increases the damage done by your Earth Shock, Flame Shock, Frost Shock and Elemental Blast spells by 15%.  Capstone Bonus: Dealing damage with a Shaman Shock spell increases your damage with that magic school by 5% for 12 seconds.

Name: Call of Flame
Description: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and Fire Nova by 15%.    Increases the damage done by your Lava Burst spell by 6%.

Name: Call of Thunder
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Thunderstorm spells by an additional 5%.

Name: Concussion
Description: Increases your Frost, Fire, and Nature damage done by 5%.

Name: Convection
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Burst, Earthquake and Wind Shear spells by 15%.

Name: Elemental Devastation
Description: Your direct offensive spell critical hits increase your critical strike chance with melee and ranged attacks by 9% for 10 sec.

Name: Elemental Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells by 6 yards.   This does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Your direct damage Fire, Nature and Frost spells on targets further than 20 yards away from you have a 33% chance to increase your magic damage by 6% for 10 sec. This effect can only occur once every 15 sec.

Name: Elemental Warding
Description: Reduces all Fire, Frost and Nature damage taken by 6%.    Reduces all damage that your Tethered Elemental suffers by 15% and increases their threat by 150%.

Name: Eye of the Storm
Description: Increases your haste by 2%.     Reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 70%.

Name: Improved Lightning Bolt
Description: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt by 0.3 sec and increases its damage by 6%.

Name: Lava Flows
Description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Lava Burst, Flame Shock, Sundering and Lava Lash by an additional 25%.    Casting Flame Shock or Lava Burst your spell and melee haste is increased by 6% for 12 sec.    If your Flame Shock is dispelled your haste is increased by 30% for 8 sec.

Name: Lightning Mastery
Description: Your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Thunderstorm criticals have a 15% chance to increase your spell critical strike damage bonus by 50% for 6 seconds.

Name: Lightning Overload
Description: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 20% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage. This chance is tripled for critical strikes.

Name: Power of the Elements
Description: Grants you and your tethered elemental an effect based on its active element.  Fire: Increases critical strike chance and hit chance for you and your elemental by 5%.  Water: Increases healing done for you and your elemental and reduces the mana cost of all spells by 5%.  Air: Increases haste for you and your elemental and reduces magical damage taken by 5%.  Earth: Reduces damage taken by you and your elemental by 5% and increases stamina by 5%.  Other Elementals: Increases all damage done by 5% and decreases all damage taken by 5%.

Name: Raze
Description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 3%.

Name: Reverberation
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shaman Shocks by 1.5 sec.     When you deal damage with a Shaman Shock spell you have a 100% to increase the direct damage of your next different Shaman Shock or Elemental Blast spell within 8 sec by 20%.

Name: Rising Flames
Description: Increases the cast speed of your Searing Totem by 30% and the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma totems by 100%.     Reduces the cooldown of Fire Nova by 4 sec. and increases its damage by 20%.

Name: Shamanism
Description: Increases the spell damage scaling of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 20%.    You have a 100% chance when dealing Nature damage to reduce the cooldown of Elemental Mastery and Thunderstorm by 1 second.  Capstone Bonus: Increases the amount of haste granted by your Elemental Mastery by an additional 5%.

Name: Storm, Earth and Fire
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Chain Lightning spell by 2.5 sec.    Earthbind Totem has a 100% chance to root targets for 5 sec when cast.    The periodic damage done by your Flame Shock is increased by 60%.

Name: Unrelenting Storm
Description: Your direct damaging Nature spells and abilities increase your haste by 3% for 8 sec. This effect stacks up to 3 times.  Capstone Bonus: At three stacks of  Unrelenting Storm, your Chain Lightning now causes the target to take 13% increased spell damage for 12 seconds. This does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Ancestral Knowledge
Description: Increases your Intellect by 6%.    Reduces the mana cost of your Shaman spells by 10%.

Name: Anticipation
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 3%.     Reduces the duration of all Disarm effects used against you by 50%. This does not stack with other Disarm duration reducing effects.

Name: Dual Wield Specialization
Description: Increases your hit chance while dual wielding by 3%.     Your off-hand auto attacks have a chance to increase your Fire, Frost, and Nature damage dealt by 6% for 8 sec.

Name: Earth's Grasp
Description: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 50% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 20%, and reduces the cooldown of both totems by 30%.

Name: Earthen Power
Description: Using Earthbind Totem has a 100% chance to remove all slow effects from you and nearby friendly targets.    Your Earth Shock reduces enemy attack speed by an additional 10%.

Name: Elemental Weapons
Description: Increases the damage caused by your Windfury Weapon effect by 30%.    Increases the spell damage on your Flametongue Weapon by 60%.    Increases the Frost spell damage granted on your Frostbrand Weapon by 100%.    Increases the bonus healing on your Earthliving Weapon by 100%.

Name: Empowered Stormstrike
Description: Your Stormstrike will deal an additional 25% weapon damage as Fire when you have a weapon imbued with Flametongue and an additional 25% weapon damage as Frost when you have a weapon imbued with Frostbrand.     After casting Stormstrike your auto-attacks will deal an additional 0 Nature damage for 8 sec.

Name: Enhanced Weapon Mastery
Description: Increases all damage done by 10%.    The all-damage increase does not stack with Unending Fury, Answered Prayers, Blessed Weapons, Blood Gorged or Blood Presence. Only the highest increase applies.

Name: Enhancing Totems
Description: Placing a totem increases your attack power by 1 and spell power by 0 for 5 minutes. This effect scales with your level.

Name: Flurry
Description: Increases your melee attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

Name: Frozen Power
Description: Increase your Frost, Fire and Nature damage done by 4% on targets affected by your Frostbrand.    Your Frost damage has a 20% chance to freeze the target for 5 sec when used on targets at or further than 15 yards from you. This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.

Name: Guardian Totems
Description: Increases the amount of armor increased by your Stoneskin Totem by 20%.    Reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 4 sec.

Name: Improved Ghost Wolf
Description: Increases movement speed and reduces damage taken in Ghost Wolf by 10%.   Capstone Bonus: Using Ghost Wolf removes all movement impairing effects and increases your speed by 60% for 2 sec. This can only occur once every 20 seconds.

Name: Improved Shields
Description: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 15%.    Increases the amount of mana gained from your Water Shield orbs by 15%.    Increases the amount of healing done by your Earth Shield orbs by 15%.

Name: Improved Stormstrike
Description: When you Stormstrike, you have a 100% chance to immediately grant you 20% of your base mana.

Name: Improved Windfury Totems
Description: Increases the melee haste granted by your Windfury totem by 4%.

Name: Maelstrom Weapon
Description: When you deal damage with a melee weapon, you have a chance (greater than previous rank) to reduce the cast time of your next damaging or healing Fire, Frost or Nature spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5.    Reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 0.5 sec per stack.

Name: Mental Dexterity
Description: Requires  Primary Stat: Agility or Duality Increases your hit rating by 15% of your Intellect.  Capstone Bonus: You gain an additional 10% of your Intellect as melee critical strike rating and 10% of your Agility as spell critical strike rating.

Name: Mental Quickness
Description: Dealing direct physical damage increases your magic damage done by 10% for 6 sec.  Dealing direct magic damage increases your physical damage done by 10% for 6 sec.  Only one damage bonus can be active at a time.

Name: Shamanistic Focus
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Shaman Shock spells by 45%.

Name: Spirit Weapons
Description: Reduces all threat generated by 30%.    Increases damage done by your Windfury and Flametongue Weapon Enhancements by 5%.

Name: Static Shock
Description: Your Lightning Shield gains 6 additional charges and you have a 15% chance to hit your target with a Lightning Shield orb charge when you deal damage with melee attacks and abilities.

Name: Thundering Strikes
Description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 5%.  Capstone Bonus: Dealing damage with spell have a chance to increases your Agility by 1 (based on your level) for 12 seconds. This effect can only trigger once every 6 seconds.

Name: Toughness
Description: Increases your Stamina by 10%, and reduces the duration of movement slowing effects on you by 30%.

Name: Unleashed Rage
Description: Increases your Expertise by 9.    Fire, Frost and Nature damage done increased by 9% while under the effects of Shamanistic Rage.     Increases all party and raid members' attack power by 10%.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Ancestral Awakening
Description: When you critically heal with your Healing Wave, Lesser Healing Wave or Riptide you summon an Ancestral spirit to aid you, instantly healing the lowest percentage health friendly party or raid target within 40 yards for 30% of the amount healed.

Name: Ancestral Healing
Description: Reduces your target's Physical damage taken by 10% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your direct healing spells.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Blessing of the Eternals
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 4%.    Increases the chance to apply the Earthliving heal over time effect on the target by 80% when they are at or under 50% total health.

Name: Focused Mind
Description: Reduces the duration of any Silence or Interrupt effects used against you by 30%. This effect does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Healing Grace
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.    Reduces the chance your helpful Shaman spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by 30%.    Capstone Bonus: All threat generated is reduced by 30%. This capstone effect does not stack with similar capstone effects.

Name: Healing Way
Description: Increases the amount healed by your Chain Heal, Earth Shield, Healing Rain, Healing Wave and Riptide by 25%.

Name: Improved Chain Heal
Description: Increases the amount healed by your Chain Heal spell by 20%.

Name: Improved Earth Shield
Description: Increases the amount of charges for your Earth Shield by 3.    Increases the healing done by your Earth Shield by 15%.  Capstone Bonus: Healing with Earth Shield grants you one stack of Tidal Waves. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds. This requires the final rank of Tidal Waves.

Name: Improved Healing Wave
Description: Increases the healing done by Healing Wave by 6% and critical strike chance by 3%.

Name: Improved Reincarnation
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 15 min and increases the amount of health and mana recovered when reincarnating by an additional 20%.

Name: Improved Water Shield
Description: Your Nature critical heals have a 30% and normal heals a 15% chance to restore mana as if you consumed a Water Shield Orb. This chance is doubled with Healing Wave.

Name: Natural Focus
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by 70%.

Name: Nature's Blessing
Description: Increases your healing power by an amount equal to 12% of your Intellect.

Name: Nature's Guardian
Description: Increases your haste by 3%.     Capstone Bonus: Whenever a damaging non-periodic attack brings you below 30% health you are healed for a small amount (increased by healing power) and your next Nature spell is guaranteed to critically strike. Has a 30 second cooldown.

Name: Purification
Description: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.    The healing increase does not stack with Spiritual Healing, Gift of Nature or Answered Prayers. Only the highest increase applies.

Name: Restorative Totems
Description: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 20%, and increases the amount healed by your Healing Stream Totem by 45%.

Name: Tidal Focus
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Shaman healing spells by 12%.

Name: Tidal Mastery
Description: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shaman healing spells, Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 3% and reduces the cooldown of your Tidal Force by 18 seconds.  Capstone Bonus: Healing Wave and Riptide direct criticals add 2 seconds, Lesser Healing Wave 1 second and Chain Heal criticals 0.5 sec to the duration of Tidal Force.

Name: Tidal Waves
Description: Your Chain Heals and Riptides have a 100% chance to grant you Tidal Waves. reducing the cast time of your Healing Waves by 10% per charge and increases the critical effect chance of your Lesser Healing Waves by 10% per charge. Chain Heal grants three charges and Riptide grants two.   Your Healing Wave and Lesser Healing Wave spells gains an additional 12% of your bonus healing effects.

Name: Totemic Focus
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your totems by 50% and for every totem active, you gain 1 Haste and Critical Strike Rating.  This effect can stack up to 4 times and is increased per totem active.

Name: Amplify Curse
Description: Reduces the global cooldown of your Curses by 0.5 sec.

Name: Contagion
Description: Increases the damage of Curse of Agony, Corruption and Seed of Corruption by 6% and reduces the chance your helpful Affliction spells and damage over time effects  will be dispelled by an additional 30%.

Name: Death's Embrace
Description: Increases the amount drained by your Drain Life by 30% while your health is at or below 20% health.    Increases the damage done by your spells and abilities by 12% when your target is at or below 35% health.

Name: Empowered Corruption
Description: Increases the spell damage scaling of Corruption by 30%.

Name: Eradication
Description: When you deal damage with Corruption, you have 15% chance to increase your haste by 20% for 10 sec.

Name: Everlasting Affliction
Description: Increases the spell damage scaling of your Corruption and Unstable Affliction by 25%.    Direct shadow damage has a 100% chance to reset the duration of your Corruption spell on the target.

Name: Fel Concentration
Description: Increases haste by 2%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by 70%    Capstone Bonus: Your periodic magic damage heals you for 20% of the damage done while casting any damaging spell. (This heal cannot exceed 5% of your maximum health)

Name: Grim Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells with a channeling or cast time by 6 yards.     This does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Dealing periodic Shadow damage to an enemy within melee range has a 33% chance to trigger a Grim Strike, dealing Shadow damage and reducing the target's melee attack power by 2 for 30 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects. This effect can only occur once every 15 sec.

Name: Improved Corruption
Description: Increases the damage done by your Corruption by 9%.    Increases the critical strike chance of your Seed of Corruption by 3%.

Name: Improved Curse of Agony
Description: Increases the damage done by your Curse of Agony by 10%.

Name: Improved Curse of Weakness
Description: Increases the amount of attack power reduced by your Curse of Weakness by 20%.

Name: Improved Drain Soul
Description: Returns 25% of your maximum mana if the target is killed by you while you drain its soul. The target must grant experience or honor.    Your Affliction spells generate 20% less threat.

Name: Improved Fear
Description: Your Fear inflicts a Nightmare on the target when the fear effect ends. The Nightmare effect reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 2 sec.

Name: Improved Felhunter
Description: Your Felhunter regains 8% of its maximum mana each time it hits with its Shadow Bite ability and the cooldown on that ability is reduced by 4 sec.     In addition, the effect of your Felhunter's Fel Intelligence is increased by 10%.

Name: Improved Howl of Terror
Description: Reduces the cast time of Howl of Terror by 1.5 sec.

Name: Improved Life Tap
Description: Increases the effect of Life Tap by 20%.

Name: Malediction
Description: Increases all damage done by 3%.    Increases the periodic critical strike chance of your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells by 15%.

Name: Nightfall
Description: Your shadow damage over time effects have a 8% chance for your next Shadow Bolt or Seed of Corruption spell becomes an instant cast and consumes 25% less mana.    This effect can only occur once every 5 sec.

Name: Pandemic
Description: Grants the periodic damage from your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells the ability to critically hit.    Increases the damage of your Corruption, Unstable Affliction and Haunt by 20%.

Name: Shadow Embrace
Description: Direct damaging Shadow spells and abilities, Drain Life and Drain Soul apply Shadow Embrace, increasing all periodic Shadow damage you deal to the target by 5% and reducing all periodic healing and absorbs on the target by 5%. Lasts for 15 sec. Stacks up to 3 times.

Name: Shadow Mastery
Description: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 6% and your Felhunter's Shadow Bite ability by 9%.

Name: Siphon Life
Description: When you deal damage with your Corruption spell, you are instantly healed for 20% of the damage done.     (Up to 5% of your Maximum Health).    Your Corruption, Seed of Corruption and Unstable Affliction damage over time effects are increased by 5%.

Name: Soul Siphon
Description: Increases the amount drained by your Drain Life and Drain Soul spells by an additional 6% for each of your Affliction effects on the target, up to a maximum of 18% additional effect.

Name: Suppression
Description: Increases your chance to hit with spells by 3%, and reduces the mana cost of your Affliction spells by 6%.

Name: Burning Resolve
Description: Increases your Parry chance by 3% and Stamina by 3%.

Name: Decimation
Description: Dealing direct damage with Fire or Shadow spells to targets below 35% health reduces the cast time of Soul Fire by 40% and increases number of Wild Imps spawned by your Hand of Gul'dan is by 2 for 10 sec.    Soul Fires cast under the effect of Decimation cost no shard.

Name: Demon Hide
Description: Increases your maximum health while in Dark Apotheosis by 25%.

Name: Demonic Aegis
Description: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin by 30%.    Increases the effectiveness of your Fel Armor by 30%.    Increases the armor contribution from cloth items while in Dark Apotheosis by 200%.

Name: Demonic Brutality
Description: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice and Suffering spells by 30%.    Increases the attack power bonus on your Felguard's Demonic Frenzy effect by 3%.

Name: Demonic Embrace
Description: Increases your total Stamina by 6%.

Name: Demonic Knowledge
Description: Increases your spell damage by an amount equal to 12% of the total of your active demon's Stamina plus Intellect.

Name: Demonic Pact
Description: Increases your spell damage done by 10%.    Your Summoned Demon's spell criticals increase spell power of yourself, party and raid members by 5% of your Spell Damage for 45 sec.    This effect has a 20 sec cooldown. Does not work on Enslaved demons.

Name: Demonic Resilience
Description: Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee and spells by 6%.    Reduces all damage your summoned demon and dominated demon takes by 15%.

Name: Demonic Tactics
Description: Increases melee and spell critical strike chance for you, your tamed pet, and your Wild Imps by 10%.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Fel Synergy
Description: You have a 100% chance to heal your pet for 15% of the amount of spell damage done by you.

Name: Fel Vitality
Description: Increases the Stamina and Intellect of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard by 30%.    Increases your maximum health and mana by 3%.

Name: Improved Demon Skin
Description: Increases the healing received by Demon Skin by 5%.    Increases the armor given by your Demon Skin by 60%.

Name: Improved Demonic Tactics
Description: Increases your Wild Imps and tamed pet's critical strike chance equal to 30% of your spell critical strike chance.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Improved Health Funnel
Description: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 20%. and reduces the health cost by 20%.     Your summoned Demon takes 30% less damage while under the effect of your Health Funnel.

Name: Improved Healthstone
Description: Increases your stamina by 2%.    Increases the healing you take from healthstones by 20%.

Name: Improved Imp
Description: Increases the damage dealt by your Imp and Wild Imps by 30% and the effect of Fire Shield and Blood Pact by 20%.

Name: Improved Succubus
Description: Reduces the cast time of your Succubus' Seduction by 66%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%.

Name: Inner Demons
Description: Increases the healing received by Demon Skin by an additional 10%.    Increases the Stamina benefit of Demonic Embrace by 100%.

Name: Mana Feed
Description: When you gain mana from Drain Mana or Life Tap spells, your tamed pet gains 150% of the mana you gain.    Your tamed pet regenerates 6% of its missing mana every 5 sec.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Master Conjuror
Description: Increases the combat ratings gained from your conjured Firestone and Spellstone by 300%.

Name: Master Demonologist
Description: Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.  Imp - Increases your Fire damage by 5%, and increases the critical effect chance of your Fire spells by 5%.  Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 10%.  Succubus - Increases your Shadow damage by 5%, and increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 5%.  Felhunter - Reduces all spell damage taken by 10%.  Felguard - Increases all damage done by 5%, and reduces all damage taken by 5%.  Enslaved Demons - Increases all damage done by 5%, and reduces all damage taken by 5%.

Name: Master Summoner
Description: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Fel Guard Summoning spells by 4 sec and the Mana cost by 40%.    Increases the duration of your Infernal and Doomguard summons by 6 min and your Wild Imps from Hand of Gul'Dan by 5 sec.

Name: Molten Core
Description: Increases the duration of your Immolate by 9 sec. Dealing damage with Corruption has a 12% chance to grant you Molten Core.    Molten Core empowers your next 3 spells cast within 15 sec:    Incinerate - Increases damage done by 18% and reduces cast time by 30%.    Soul Fire - Increases damage done by 18% and increases critical strike chance by 15%.

Name: Nemesis
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Demonic Empowerment, Metamorphosis, Inferno, Ritual of Doom, and Fel Domination spells by 30%, and the cooldown of your Demonic Leap by 15 seconds.  Capstone Bonus: While in Metamorphosis, your Hand of Gul'dan can be cast twice within 6 sec before going on cooldown.

Name: Shadowflame Claws
Description: While in Dark Apotheosis, your Shadow, Fire, and Physical spells and abilities deal 9% more damage and generate 30% more threat.

Name: Unholy Power
Description: Increases the damage done by your Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard's melee attacks, your Imp's Firebolt and the Firebolt of your Wild Imps by 35%.     Increases the critical strike chance of your Hand of Gul'dan by 15%.

Name: Abyssal Insight
Description: Increases your Spell penetration by 1, scaling with your level.

Name: Aftermath
Description: Increases the periodic damage done by your Immolate by 6%.    Your Conflagrate has a 100% chance to daze the target, reducing movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

Name: Backdraft
Description: When you cast Conflagrate, Mind Blast, Shadowfury or Shadowburn, the cast or channel time of  your next 3 Shadow or Fire spells is reduced by 30%. Lasts 15 sec.     Increases the damage of your Shadowburn by 20%.

Name: Backlash
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.    You have a 25% chance when hit by a physical attack to reduce the cast time of your next Shadow Bolt or Incinerate spell by 100%. This effect lasts 12 sec.    Cannot occur more than once every 8 seconds.

Name: Bane
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Shadow Bolt, Chaos Bolt, Immolate, Hand of Gul'dan, Soul Fire and Shadowflame by 6% and reduces the mana cost of these spells by 15%.

Name: Cataclysm
Description: Increases the damage of your Rain of Fire, Hellfire, Inferno, Hand of Gul'dan and Shadowfury by 18%.

Name: Demonic Power
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Succubus' Lash of Pain spell by 6 sec.    Reduces the cast time of your Imp's Firebolt and the Firebolt of your Wild Imps by 0.5 sec, and increases their damage by 14%.

Name: Destructive Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells with a channeling or cast time by 6 yards.   This does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Your spell critical strike chance is increased against enemies further than 20 yards from you by 4%.

Name: Devastation
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 5%.

Name: Emberstorm
Description: Increases the damage done by your Fire and Shadow spells by 5%.

Name: Empowered Imp
Description: Increases the damage done by your Summoned Imp's Firebolt by 30% and critical strike damage bonus by 100%.    Your Imp's Firebolt critical strikes have a 100% chance to increase the spell critical strike chance of your next Warlock Destruction direct spell by 100%. This effect lasts 8 sec.

Name: Fire and Brimstone
Description: Increases the damage done by your direct fire spells with a cast time to targets afflicted by your Immolate by 10%.    Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 25%.

Name: Improved Immolate
Description: Increases the damage done by your Immolate spell by 30%.

Name: Improved Searing Pain
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 10%.

Name: Improved Shadow Bolt
Description: Increases the damage done by your Shadow Bolt spell by 15%.    Your Shadow Bolt has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to spell damage, increasing spell critical strike chance against that target by 5%. Effect lasts 30 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Improved Shadowburn
Description: Dealing damage with direct Shadow spells or abilities has a 30% chance to make your next Shadowburn not consume a Soul Shard and have 50% reduced cooldown.

Name: Improved Soul Leech
Description: Your Soul Leech effect also restores mana to you and your summoned demon equal to 4% of your missing mana, and has a 100% chance to grant Replenishment.    Replenishment Replenishes 1% of maximum mana per 5 sec on up to 10 party members for 15 sec.

Name: Intensity
Description: Increases all damage done by 2%.    Reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 70%.

Name: Molten Skin
Description: When hit by a melee or ranged attack you have a 9% chance of increasing your Fire damage done by 10% for 10 sec.    Reduces all damage taken by your Hellfire by 30%.

Name: Nether Protection
Description: Gives you a 30% chance when being hit with a spell or taking periodic spell damage to gain Nether Protection, reducing all damage by that spell school by 10% for 6 sec. This effect can only occur once every 4 sec.

Name: Pyroclasm
Description: When you critically strike with Searing Pain, Scorch, or Conflagrate, your Fire and Shadow spell damage is increased by 6% for 10 sec.

Name: Ruin
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.     This does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Increases your Fire and Shadow damage done by 2%. This effect is quadrupled against targets above 75% health.

Name: Shadow and Flame
Description: Increases the spell damage scaling of your Shadow Bolt, Shadowburn, Chaos Bolt, Shadowfury, Soul Fire, Hand of Gul'dan, Incinerate and Shadowflame by 20%.

Name: Soul Leech
Description: Your direct Shadow damage and your Soul Fire, Incinerate, Searing Pain and Conflagrate spells have a 30% chance to heal you for 20% of the damage caused.    Returns up to a maximum of 15% of your health.

Name: Anger Management
Description: Generates 6 rage per 3 seconds.

Name: Blood Frenzy
Description: Increases your melee attack speed by 10%.      Rend and Deep Wounds increase all Physical damage caused to that target by 4%.   Does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Deep Wounds
Description: Your melee critical strikes cause the opponent to bleed, dealing 48% of your melee weapon's average damage over 6 sec.    While wielding a single Two-Handed weapon, the periodic damage from Deep Wounds can critically strike.

Name: Deflection
Description: Increases your Parry chance by 3%.    Does not stack with other Deflection talents.

Name: Impale
Description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Warrior abilities by 20%.

Name: Improved Charge
Description: Increases the amount of rage generated by your Charge ability by 10.

Name: Improved Hamstring
Description: Increases the damage of your Hamstring by 15%.  Capstone Bonus: Your Hamstring ability will immobilize the target for 3 sec. This effect cannot occur more than once every 10 sec.

Name: Improved Heroic Strike
Description: Increases the damage of your Heroic Strike by 9% and reduces the rage cost by 6.

Name: Improved Mortal Strike
Description: Increases the damage caused by your Mortal Strike ability by 10%, reduces the cooldown by 2 sec, and increases the healing reduction effect by 10%.

Name: Improved Overpower
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 50%.

Name: Improved Rend
Description: Increases the bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 20%.

Name: Improved Slam
Description: Increases the damage of Slam by 20% and reduces its swing time by 1 sec.

Name: Iron Will
Description: Reduces the duration of all Stun and Charm effects used against you by 20%.  This does not stack with other Stun reduction effects.

Name: Juggernaut
Description: Following a Charge or Heroic Leap, you have a 100% chance for your next Slam to critically hit and your next Mortal Strike to apply Rend. (If learned)     Reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 4 sec.

Name: Mace Specialization
Description: Increases your armor penetration by 30% while a mace is equipped.

Name: Poleaxe Specialization
Description: Increases your physical critical damage and melee physical critical strike chance while an Axe or Polearm is equipped in your main hand by 5%.

Name: Second Wind
Description: Whenever you are struck by a Stun or Immobilize effect you will generate 20 rage and 10% of your total health over 10 sec.

Name: Strength of Arms
Description: Increases your total Strength by 4%, Stamina by 2% and Expertise by 2.    After using Overpower, Slam or Execute your next Mortal Strike causes 10% extra damage and cost 5 less rage. Stacks up to 2 times.

Name: Sudden Death
Description: Your direct damaging attacks have a chance (greater than previous rank) of allowing the use of Execute regardless of the target's health state.    You keep at least 3 rage after using Execute.

Name: Sword Specialization
Description: Increases your chance to hit with spells and abilities by 5%.    Gives you a 10% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after hitting your target with your Sword dealing 120% weapon damage.     This damage is increased by 40% while wielding a single Two-Handed Weapon.

Name: Tactical Mastery
Description: Requires a Single Two-Handed or One-Handed Weapon.  Increases armor contribution from armor by 40% and increases the damage of Devastate by 25%.  Capstone Bonus: Stagger 30% of damage taken from attacks, distributing it over 10 seconds. This staggered damage does not break crowd control effects.  Does not work with Titan's Grip, Touched by the Light, or when Primary Stat is Spirit. Stagger is half as effective against players

Name: Taste for Blood
Description: Whenever your Rend ability causes damage, you have a 100% chance of allowing the use of your Overpower ability for 9 sec.     This effect will not occur more than once every 6 sec.

Name: Trauma
Description: Your melee critical strikes increase the effectiveness of Bleed effects on the target by 30% for 1 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Two-Handed Weapon Mastery
Description: You generate 25% more rage from damage dealt.  This effect is only active while wielding a single Two-Handed Weapon. (Does not work with Titan's Grip.)

Name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
Description: Increases the physical damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 6%.

Name: Unrelenting Assault
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Overpower and Revenge abilities by 4 sec and increases the damage done by both abilities by 20%.    If you strike a player with Overpower while they are casting, their magical damage and healing will be reduced by 50% for 6 sec.

Name: Weapon Mastery
Description: Whenever one of your attacks is dodged or blocked you have a 50% chance to gain 2% critical strike chance for 8 sec, stacks up to 3 times.     Reduces the duration of all Disarm effects used against you by 30%.      This does not stack with other Disarm duration reducing effects.

Name: Wrecking Crew
Description: Your melee critical hits enrage you, increasing all damage caused by 10% for 12 sec.  This effect does not stack with Enrage or trigger Enrage effects.

Name: Armored to the Teeth
Description: Increases your melee attack power by 3 for every 150 armor value you have.

Name: Blood Craze
Description: Regenerates 6% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike.

Name: Bloodsurge
Description: Increases the duration of Bloodbath by 3 sec.     Damaging spells and abilities have a 100% chance of making your next Bloodthirst cost no rage, trigger no cooldown, ignore 50% of the target's armor and refresh Bloodbath on the target.     This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.

Name: Booming Voice
Description: Increases the duration of your Battle Shout, Demoralizing Shout and Commanding Shout by 50% and increases their area of effect by 50%.     Increases the melee attack power reduction of your Demoralizing Shout by 20%.

Name: Brutal Pummel
Description: Pummel applies two stacks of Sunder Armor to the target. If used when you are below 35% health, Pummel also Pacifies the target for 1 sec, preventing them from attacking.     Capstone Bonus: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Pummel now also deals 4 damage (increased by attack power).    Sunder Armor Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 30 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Commanding Presence
Description: Battle Shout increases your Strength by 0 and Commanding Shout increases your Stamina by 0 for 1 |4hour:hrs;. These effects scale with your level.

Name: Cruelty
Description: Increases your melee and ranged critical strike chance by 5%.    Increases your total Strength by 5%.

Name: Dance of Death
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 6% when your health is below 75%.    Capstone Bonus: Killing an enemy that grants experience or honor or using Siegebreaker will heal you for 205, increased by attack power and reset your Intercept cooldown.    This effect can only occur once every 5 sec.

Name: Dual Wield Mastery
Description: Increases your melee attack speed by 10%.    Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 33%.  Does not stack with Dual Wield Specialization

Name: Enrage
Description: Increases your Physical damage by 10% and haste by 10% for 12 sec after using Bloodrage, Berserker Rage or Recklessness.  Capstone Bonus: This effect also trigger from being struck by a damaging attack while below 50% health. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds.

Name: Fervor
Description: Increases your hit chance by 3%.     Increases your critical strike chance by 3% while in Berserker Stance.

Name: Furious Attacks
Description: Your melee attacks have a chance to reduce all healing done to the target by 25% for 10 sec. This can stack up to 2 times. This occurs more often than Furious Attacks (Rank 1).  Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Improved Berserker Stance
Description: Berserker Stance now also increases your damage against targets below 35% health by 9%. This effect is doubled while Enrage is active.  Capstone Bonus: Raging Blow increases the duration of your Recklessness by 1 second.

Name: Improved Cleave
Description: Increases the bonus damage done by your Cleave ability by 120%.

Name: Improved Execute
Description: Reduces the rage cost of your Execute ability by 6.

Name: Improved Intercept
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 10 sec.

Name: Improved Victory Rush
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Victory Rush by 60% and gives you a 100% when you parry to allow the use of Victory Rush for 10 sec.     This effect may only occur once every 12 seconds.

Name: Improved Whirlwind
Description: Increases the damage of your Whirlwind ability by 20%.

Name: Intensify Rage
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Bloodrage, Recklessness and Death Wish abilities by 33%.

Name: Raging Berserker
Description: Using Berserker Rage or Heroic Fury will generate 50 rage. If used while below 50% health, your melee abilities are empowered for 5 sec, causing them to drain life from targets hit.

Name: Sharpened Edges
Description: Armored to the Teeth now increases attack power for every 108 armor instead of every 150.

Name: Shredding Blows
Description: Direct melee and ranged critical strikes increase your armor penetration by 24% for your next 3 attacks.

Name: Sidearm Specialization
Description: Increases your armor penetration by 18% and your hit chance by 3%.  Capstone Bonus: All threat generated is reduced by 30%. This capstone effect does not stack with similar capstone effects

Name: Unbridled Wrath
Description: Gives you a chance to generate 2 additional rage points when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

Name: Unending Fury
Description: Increases your damage done by 9%.  Capstone Bonus: While Bloodrage is active Fear effect durations are reduced by 30%.    The all-damage increase does not stack with Enhanced Weapon Mastery, Answered Prayers, Blessed Weapons, Blood Gorged or Blood Presence. Only the highest increase applies.

Name: Anticipation
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 5%.    Does not stack with other Anticipation talents.

Name: Critical Block
Description: Your successful blocks now further reduce the damage you take from the blocked hit by 25%. This effect does not work against players.     Increases your chance to critically hit with your Shield Slam ability by 10%.  Does not work with Touched by the Light.

Name: Damage Shield
Description: Whenever you take direct damage from or block a melee attack you cause damage equal to 20% of your block value.

Name: Defensive Mindset
Description: Leaving Defensive Stance no longer applies the Defensive Mindset debuff.

Name: Firm Grip
Description: Increases your armor value from your equipped Shield by 30%.    Increases your Stamina by 3%.    Increases your block value by 6%.

Name: Focused Rage
Description: Reduces the rage cost of your abilities by 3.  Capstone Bonus: You gain 5 Rage every time the target of your Vigilance takes damage. This effect can only occur once every second.|r

Name: Gag Order
Description: Gives your Shield Bash and Heroic Throw a 100% chance to silence the target for 3 sec.     Increases the damage of your Shield Slam ability by 10%.

Name: Improved Bloodrage
Description: Increases the rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.    While in Defensive Stance your Bloodrage reduces your damage taken by 4%.

Name: Improved Defensive Stance
Description: Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee and spells by 6%.    When you Block, Parry or Dodge an attack you have a 100% chance to become Enraged, increasing Physical damage caused by 6% for 12 sec.

Name: Improved Disarm
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 20 sec and causes the target to take an additional 10% damage while disarmed.

Name: Improved Disciplines
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall, Retaliation, Avatar, and Recklessness abilities by 60 sec.

Name: Improved Revenge
Description: Increases damage of your Revenge ability by 30% and causes Revenge to strike an additional 2 target.     After using Revenge your next Devastate within 8 sec will strike an additional target.

Name: Improved Spell Reflection
Description: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by spells by 4% and when the ability is used it will reflect the first spell cast against the 4 closest party members within 20 yards.

Name: Improved Thunder Clap
Description: Reduces the cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 12 rage points and increases the damage by 30% and the slowing effect by an additional 10%.

Name: Incite
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Heroic Strike, Thunder Clap and Cleave abilities by 15%.

Name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
Description: Increases Physical damage you deal when a one-handed melee weapon is equipped by 10%.

Name: Puncture
Description: Reduces the rage cost of your Devastate ability by 3.    Your attacks ignore an additional 12% of your target's armor.

Name: Resolve
Description: Increases your Strength by 6%, Stamina by 9% and your Expertise by 6.

Name: Safeguard
Description: Reduces damage taken by the target of your Intervene ability by 30% for 6 sec.

Name: Shield Mastery
Description: Increases your block value by 30% and reduces the cooldown of your Shield Block ability by 20 sec.

Name: Shield Specialization
Description: Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 10%.    You have a 100% chance to generate 5 rage when a block, dodge, or parry occurs.

Name: Sword and Board
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Devastate by 15%.    Casting an ability that costs rage has a 30% chance to reset the cooldown of Shield Slam, make it cost no rage and increase its damage by 10%.

Name: Thunderstruck
Description: Increases the damage of Shockwave and Thunder Clap by 36%.

Name: Warbringer
Description: Your Charge, Intercept, and Intervene abilities have a 100% chance to remove all slowing effects when used.
